Description: Khaitan Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited manufactures and sells single super phosphate (SSP), sulphuric acid, and other chemicals in India. The company operates through Fertilizer, Chemicals & Specialty Chemicals, and Others segments. It also provides plain, zincated, and boronated SSP fertilizers in powder and granulated forms under the Khaitan SSP and Utsav SSP brands for use in crops. In addition, the company produces sulphuric acid, which is used in manufacturing of SSP fertilizers, copper sulphate, zinc sulphate, ferrous sulphate, and health medicines; sulphur trioxide and oleum that are used for the production of plastics, detergents, and dyestuffs. Further, it offers linier alkyl benzene sulphonic acid, which is used to produce detergent and cake for washing the clothes, as well as manufactures and sells crude soya oil and de-oiled cakes; and refined vegetable oil under the Khaitan Vegetable Oil brand. Additionally, the company generates steam and sells wind power. Khaitan Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Indore, India.

Name: Not Found
Description: United Leasing & Industries Limited manufactures and sells embroidered fabrics in India. It also holds real estate land parcel in the district of Gurugram in Haryana. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: National Oxygen Limited
Description: National Oxygen Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial gases in liquid and gaseous forms primarily in India. The company's products include industrial liquid oxygen and nitrogen; industrial gaseous oxygen and nitrogen; medical grade oxygen liquid and gas; high purity nitrogen gas; industrial argon gas; and dissolved acetylene gas. It serves government workshops; hospitals; public sector, space, petrochemical, refrigeration, and ship making and repairing units; and steel, pharmaceutical, and fabrication sectors. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: Gillette India Limited
Description: Gillette India Limited manufactures and sells grooming and oral care products in India and internationally. The company offers shaving system and cartridges, blades, toiletries, razors, and other components. It also offers toothbrushes and oral care products. In addition, the company provides body shaving and trimming, skin care, and aftershave products; and female grooming products under the Venus brand name. The company sells its products primarily under the GilletteLabs, SkinGuard Sensitive, Fusion5, MACH3, Disposable Razor, Guard3, and Styler brand names. Gillette India Limited markets and sells its products through mass merchandisers, grocery stores, membership club stores, drug stores, department stores, and high frequency stores. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Wires and Fabriks (S.A.) Limited
Description: Wires and Fabriks (S.A.) Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of paper mill products in India and internationally. It offers a range of forming fabrics; woven and spiral dryer screens; polyester, polyamide, and Kynar pulp fabrics; stuffed spiral screen and herring bone weave press belts; woven and spiral conveyor belts; and stainless-steel mesh products, such as diagonal seams, mould and dandy covers, open ended products, cable meshes, seams, and edges. The company also provides diagonal seam and open-ended phosphor bronze mesh wires; and accessories comprising nozzles, doctoring systems and holders, dewatering systems, coater blades, water and fiber recovery products, tail cutters, oscillators, showers, doctor blades, and filters, as well as tensiometers. In addition, it offers paper making chemicals, including retention and drainage aids, defoamer, deposit control, deinking, binder, tissue processing, cleaning, activated bentonite, paper coating, OBA, water treatment, surface size, dispersant, lubricant, insolubilizer, and lint control products; and generates wind power. It also exports its products. Wires and Fabriks (S.A.) Limited was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Jaipur, India. Wires and Fabriks (S.A.) Limited is a subsidiary of W & F Securities Pvt Ltd.

Name: Computer Point Limited
Description: Computer Point Limited engages in the provision of software training services in India. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Kolkata, India.

Name: Mac Charles (India) Limited
Description: Mac Charles (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation of electricity through wind turbine generators in India. The company constructs and leases commercial real estate properties. Mac Charles (India) Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Bengaluru, India. The company is a subsidiary of Embassy Property Developments Private Limited.

Name: Addi Industries Limited
Description: Addi Industries Limited, together with its subsidiary, Aum Texfab Private Limited, manufactures, markets, sells, and exports knitwear fabrics and ready garments in India. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

Name: Pioneer Investcorp Limited
Description: Pioneer Investcorp Limited provides investment banking and financial advisory services in India. It offers a range of investment banking services, including private equity advisory, merchant banking, corporate finance advisory and strategic alliances, debt syndication, structured transactions, and mergers and acquisition advisory services. The company also provides private equity advisory services, such as venture and growth capital, structured finance, buyout/control transactions, and special situation finance services; institutional securities trading services for government securities, state development loans, non-SLR bonds, corporate bonds, and money market instruments; portfolio management services; and insurance and reinsurance advisory services. In addition, it offers capital raising, private equity, debt arranging and restructuring, and project finance services. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Ashnoor Textile Mills Limited
Description: Ashnoor Textile Mills Limited manufactures and sells terry towels in India, the United States, and internationally. The company offers white, colored, pool, and kitchen towels to the hospitality industry. It operates through a network of retail chains and distributors. Ashnoor Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Gurugram, India.

Name: Unitech Limited
Description: Unitech Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development and related activities in India. The company is also involved in the property management, hospitality, power transmission, consultancy, construction, rental, and investment businesses. In addition, it is involved in the installation of power transmission towers. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.

Name: V.I.P. Industries Limited
Description: V.I.P. Industries Limited manufactures and sells luggage, backpacks, and accessories in India. It provides hard luggage and soft luggage bags, including school bags, trolleys, backpacks, suitcases, executive cases, duffels, overnight travel solutions, and handbags. The company offers its products primarily under the VIP, Caprese, Carlton, Skybags, Alfa, and Aristocrat brands through multi-brand outlets, exclusive brand outlets, canteen stores department, and e-commerce platforms. It also exports its products. V.I.P. Industries Limited was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Fiberweb (India) Limited
Description:
Fiberweb (India) Limited manufactures and sells spunbond and melt-blown polypropylene nonwoven fabrics from polypropylene in India. It offers garments and industrial materials.
The company's products are used in hygiene, agriculture crop cover, medical and industrial garments, automotive, geotextiles/structural engineering, and textile industries, as well as oil absorbents, electronics, filtration, apparels, and sanitary products. It exports its products to the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, and Gulf countries. The company was formerly known as PVD Plast Mould Industries Limited. Fiberweb (India) Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: LKP Finance Limited
Description: LKP Finance Limited, a non-banking financial institution, engages in the financing and trading of shares, securities, and derivatives in India. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: East Buildtech Limited
Description: East Buildtech Limited engages in the real estate business in India. The company acquires land; and erects and constructs houses, flats, shops, offices, stores, apartments, buildings, etc. It is also involved in infrastructure development. The company was formerly known as Chokhani Business Limited and changed its name to East Buildtech Limited. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Not Found
Description: Manipal Finance Corporation Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was engaged in hire purchase and lease financing business. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Udupi, India.

Name: Bajaj Steel Industries Limited
Description: Bajaj Steel Industries Limited manufactures and sells cotton ginning and pressing machinery in India. The company offers cotton ginning and pressing machineries, including double roller ginning machines, auto feeders, cotton baling presses, pre-cleaners, lint cleaners, cotton boll openers, air separators, battery condensers, stone remover, seed cotton conveying systems, stone catchers/rock traps, air locks, belt conveyor systems, lint conveying systems, fire detectors/diverters, distribution screw conveyors, pneumatic conveying systems, bucket elevators, fully automatic ginning plant, twin auto regulators, surge hoppers, and overflow hoppers; baling presses for other applications; tractor attachments for cotton ginning industry; delinting and decorticating machinery; components and machined parts, including spares, manifold blocks, gear blanks, windmill shafts, turbine housings, gear box assemblies, head spigots, balancing masses, hand granades, oil fan assemblies, automotive hub, winder cam, and other machined components; mechanical conveyors and elevators; and dust/waste handling systems. It provides hot air humidification systems, cold moisturizing systems, and lint slides; industrial trusses and pipelines; delinting machineries; power transmission products; truck loaders/unloaders, telescopic conveyors, and z-elevators; electrical panels and accessories; electrical panels and accessories, such as power distribution board, field panel, panel, auto main failure, and power control center and automatic power factor control panels; chimneys, hydraulipc power packs and cylinders, structures for machineries and oil refineries, gantry, tanks, and silos and other storage equipment; and pre-fabricated house. In addition, the company offers fire alarm and detection systems, fire extinguishers, and fire hydrant pumps; steel doors; laser cutting machines; and trades cotton products. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Nagpur, India.

Name: Kiduja India Limited
Description: Kiduja India Limited, a non-banking financial company, invests and deals in shares and securities in India. It also engages in futures and options trading, and mutual fund investments businesses. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Key Corp Limited
Description: Key Corp Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides vehicle financing services in India. It also invests in mutual funds. Key Corp Limited was formerly known as Key Leasing And Finance Ltd. and changed its name to Key Corp Limited in April 1996. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Kanpur, India.

Name: Gujarat Hotels Limited
Description: Gujarat Hotels Limited engages in hoteliering business in India. The company operates WelcomHotel Vadodara, a 5-star hotel in Vadodara. Gujarat Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Vadodara, India.

Name: Ras Resorts and Apart Hotels Limited
Description: Ras Resorts and Apart Hotels Limited owns and operates a hotel and resort in India. The company operates the Ras Resorts, a 4-star hotel on the bank of river Daman Ganga. Its resort offers standard airconditioned rooms, deluxe airconditioned rooms, executive airconditioned rooms, and suites; and conference halls, auditoriums, lawns, and meeting rooms. The company provides its services for social functions, parties and celebrations, cultural events, business conferences, product launches, and corporate functions. It also offers various resort facilities; and dining and entertainment services. Ras Resorts and Apart Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Paramount Cosmetics (India) Limited
Description: Paramount Cosmetics (India) Limited engages in the manufacture and marketing of cosmetic products for women in India. It offers sticker bindis, kumkum, sindoor, and kajal under the Shilpa brand; and premium cosmetic products under the KROMME brand. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

Name: Jindal Hotels Limited
Description: Jindal Hotels Limited engages in the hotel business in India. The company operates Grand Mercure Vadodara Surya Palace hotel located in Vadodara; and Azure restaurant. Its hotel includes guest rooms, large and medium banquet halls, board room, restaurant, swimming pool, health club, liquor shop, and other amenities. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Vadodara, India.

Name: Not Found
Description: Jupiter Industries and Leasing Ltd. does not have significant operations. Previously, the company was engaged in the business of equipment and machinery leasing. Jupiter Industries and Leasing Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Simmonds Marshall Limited
Description: Simmonds Marshall Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial fasteners, bolts, and studs in India and internationally. The company offers cleveloc and all metal self-locking nuts; nylon insert self-locking nuts; dome cap, slotted and castle, hose pipe fitting, flange, cage, weld, and wheel nuts; philldas products U-nuts; and cold forged sleeves/bushes collars/spacers. It serves the automotive sector. Simmonds Marshall Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: B & A Limited
Description: B & A Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the cultivation, manufacture, and sale of black tea in India. The company also manufactures and sells packaging materials comprising paper sacks and flexible laminates, as well as operates tea estates. It also offers retail tea under the Gatoonga Tea Estate brand name. The company was formerly known as Barasali Tea Estate Limited and changed its name to B & A Limited in December 2000. B & A Limited was incorporated in 1915 and is based in Kolkata, India.

Name: Hawkins Cookers Limited
Description: Hawkins Cookers Limited manufactures, trades, and sells kitchenware in India. The company offers pressure cookers; and cookware, including tavas, frying pans, deep frying pans, saucepans, cook-n-serve bowls and frying pans, handis, stewpots, sauté pans, Uttapam pan, Tpan, casserole, appe pan, grill pan, dutch ovens, kadhai, pizza makers, cake bakers, and cookware sets, as well as parts and repair services for its products. It also exports its products. Hawkins Cookers Limited was founded in 1959 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Warren Tea Limited
Description: Warren Tea Limited engages in the retailing, marketing, and trading of black tea in India and internationally. The company was founded in 1850 and is based in Kolkata, India.

Name: The Cochin Malabar Estates And Industries Limited
Description: The Cochin Malabar Estates And Industries Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was engaged in the rubber and tea plantation business in India. The company was incorporated in 1930 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

Name: Best Eastern Hotels Limited
Description: Best Eastern Hotels Limited owns and operates hotels and resorts in India. It operates hotel under the Usha Ascot name. The company's facilities include restaurant, bar, health club, spa, discotheque, indoor-outdoor recreation, and banquet halls, as well as conference facilities. It also manages resorts. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Neelamalai Agro Industries Limited
Description: Neelamalai Agro Industries Limited cultivates, manufactures, and sells tea in India and internationally. The company operates Katary and Sutton estates located in the Nilgiris District in Tamil Nadu. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: IST Limited
Description: IST Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of auto components in India. The company offers piston cooling nozzles assembly parts for four-wheelers; throttle shafts and throttle valves; carburetor and automotive assembly components; CNG kit components; and tractor and automotive assembly components. It also offers precision components and assemblies for automobile and consumer goods industries. In addition, the company provides develops and operates SEZ for the IT and ITES sectors. IST Limited also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

Name: Cosmo First Limited
Description: Cosmo First Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of bi-axially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films in India and internationally. The company offers packaging films; lamination films; label films; and industrial films to food, beverage, personal care, and pharmaceutical industries. It also offers specialty chemicals; and operates retail and services platform that provides a range of pet care products, such as food, nutritional supplements, hygiene products, accessories, and toys, as well as vet care, grooming, and training services. In addition, the company provides pathology, radiology, pharmacy, surgeries, vaccination, and consultation services for vet care practices. Further, it offers pet spa and pet products. The company was formerly known as Cosmo Films Limited and changed its name to Cosmo First Limited in July 2022. Cosmo First Limited was incorporated in 1976 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Diamant Infrastructure Limited
Description: Diamant Infrastructure Limited executes various contracts of road projects in India. The company operates through Infrastructure and Trading segments. It also undertakes SFRC rainwater drains and civil contracts; and engages in trading activities. The company was formerly known as Diamant Investment & Finance Limited and changed its name to Diamant Infrastructure Limited in March 2010. Diamant Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Nagpur, India.

Name: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited
Description: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of healthcare services in India and internationally. It operates through Healthcare Services, Retail Health & Diagnostics, Digital Health & Pharmacy Distribution, and Others segments. The company's healthcare facilities comprise primary, secondary, and tertiary care, as well as specialty facilities. It offers services in cardiac sciences, orthopedics, oncology, neurosciences, emergency, robotic surgery, and transplants; and cardiology, neurology, gastroenterology, dermatology, ophthalmology, pediatric, endocrinology, gynecology, urology, nephrology, pulmonology, rheumatology, neurosurgery, radiology, plastic-surgery, neonatology, vascular-surgery, psychiatry, dentistry, ear, nose, and throat care, as well as genomic medicines. The company also provides other services, such as project consultancy, health insurance, medical colleges, medvarsity for e-learning, and research services. In addition, it operates pharmacies, primary care clinics, birthing centers, specialized birthing centers, dialysis centers, cradle and fertility centers, diabetes management centers, single specialty clinics, primary health centers and diagnostic chains, dental clinics, and daycare and home healthcare centers. Further, the company engages in the business of bio-banking of tissues. It serves through national retail healthcare centers and genomics institutes, as well as Apollo 24/7, a digital health mobile platform; and www.apollopharmacy.in, an online pharmacy. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: Nitin Castings Limited
Description: Nitin Castings Limited manufactures, sells, and exports alloy steel castings in India and internationally. It offers immersion/dip tubes, bimetallic rollers, grate plates, hammers and diaphragm liners, tip casting blocks/sectors, and flaps and diaphragm plates for cement plants; and grate bars, tip casting blocks, upper and lower side walls, screen size rollers, chain links, side plates, locking clits, and press boards/side boards/stripper plates for steel plants. The company also provides reformer tubes, process gas heater tubes, burden feeder shafts, feed legs, etc. for DRI plants; air injection and feed tubes, coal burner and throw pipes, radiation protection tubes, swirlers, thermowells, inlet and outlet sector, and staggers for coal-based sponge iron plants; upper and lower burden feeder probes, and breaker disk and lugs for burden feeder shafts for blast furnaces; galvanizing and cold rolling mill products; products for industrial, heat treatment, and re-heating furnaces; and products for fertilizer, refinery, and petrochemical industries. In addition, it offers hot strip mill products; decanters; valves, including balls, seat rings, cages, hydrant valves, strainers, valve bodies, bonnets, yokes and discs for gate valves, globe valves, and valve bodies and discs for butterfly valves; and casings, impellers, sleeves, stuffing boxes, rotor ball diffusers, and bushes for the pump industry. Further, the company provides parts for earth moving equipment in low alloy steels; rings for metallic RTJ gaskets; anchors, pedestal door frames, and walking beams for furnaces; lift cylinders for tyre machinery; liners for slurry pumps and compressors; and disc refiners for paper mills; piercing plugs; deck panels; and rollers and guides for ERW tube plants. The company was formerly known as Nitin Alloys Global Limited and changed its name to Nitin Castings Limited in October 2016. Nitin Castings Limited was founded in 1964 and is based in Thane, India.

Name: Everest Industries Limited
Description: Everest Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and trades in building products for residential, commercial, and industrial sectors in India and internationally. The company operates through Building Products; and Steel Buildings segments. It offers roofing products, such as evercool roofing sheets, fibre cement roofing sheets, colour coated roofing sheets, hi-tech corrugated roofing profile sheets, and EPDM rubber washers; heavy duty boards, ready-made sandwich panels for walls, fibre cement ceiling boards, designer ceiling and decorative wall panels, wooden cement planks, textured wall panels, coloured cement boards, and clean room panels; and other building products and accessories. The company also provides wall solutions comprising internal and solid dry walls, fences and gates, and prefabricated buildings; ceiling solutions, such as grid and concealed ceilings, soffit, and rooftile underlay; wall cladding solutions consisting of external and internal cladding, and duct encasement; and mezzanine flooring solutions. In addition, it designs, constructs, manufactures, supplies, installs, and erects pre-engineered and smart steel buildings; and related accessories for industrial, warehousing, and infrastructure projects. The company serves various customers, including corporates, wholesalers, distributors, architects, interior designers, influencers, homeowners, and other businesses. It exports its products to 19 countries. The company was formerly known as Eternit Everest Ltd. and changed its name to Everest Industries Limited in July 2003. The company was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Everest Industries Limited is a subsidiary of Falak Investment Pvt. Ltd.

Name: Ironwood Education Limited
Description: Ironwood Education Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides vocational training services in India and internationally. The company provides vocational training in field of event management, advertising, public relations, and integrated marketing communication under the EMDI Institute of Media & Communication brand name; sports management courses under the Ironwood Sports Management Global Academy brand name; and wedding planning trainings under The Wedding Academy brand name in the fields of creativity, customs and rituals, floral and stage design, and venue and catering, as well as other aspects, such as entertainment, technology, and international practices. It offers professional training, including teaching graduates, undergraduate and working professionals in the field of event management, wedding planning, and radio jockey and programming through classroom training and workshops. The company was formerly known as Greycells Education Limited and changed its name to Ironwood Education Limited in March 2021. Ironwood Education Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: MSR India Limited
Description: MSR India Limited manufactures and sells copper water bottles, vermicelli, atta, and special purpose components for ISRO in India. The company offers copper rods, wires, bussbars, flats, and strips; and extrusion, forged and transmission terminals, rotating and grip contact, contact clips, and copper components. It also offers FMCG related products. MSR India Limited exports its products. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

Name: AYM Syntex Limited
Description: AYM Syntex Limited manufactures and sells polyester filament, nylon filament, and bulk continuous filament yarns for the textile and floor covering industries in India and internationally. The company also offers sewing threads and industrial yarns. Its products are used in various applications, including residential wall-to-wall, contract/hospitality, outdoor, and handmade carpets; rugs, bathmats, and carpet tiles; automotive products; fashion and apparel, sarees and dress materials, and hosiery and socks; home and medical textiles; narrow fabrics; and sportswear. The company sells its products under the Comfeel, Elior, Polycycle, Arcticool, Spinovate, Silque, Ultraflex, Assura, Sorenyl, Rezilia, Ecose, Silkenza, Greenova, Polymagic, Sparkle, Wonderfeel, Polywonder, Synergy, and Opulenz brands. It also exports its products to approximately 55 countries. The company was formerly known as Welspun Syntex Limited and changed its name to AYM Syntex Limited in December 2015. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. AYM Syntex Limited is a subsidiary of Mandawewala Enterprises Limited.

Name: Panasonic Carbon India Co. Limited
Description: Panasonic Carbon India Co. Limited manufactures and sells carbon rods as a component of dry cell batteries to battery manufacturers in India and internationally. It also offers IT services. The company was formerly known as Indo Matsushita Carbon Co. Limited. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Chennai, India. Panasonic Carbon India Co. Limited is a subsidiary of Panasonic Holdings Corporation.

Name: Finkurve Financial Services Limited
Description: Finkurve Financial Services Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. It offers digital personal and gold loans; and unsecured consumer loans, and short term and long term inter corporate loans. The company was formerly known as Sanjay Leasing Limited and changed its name to Finkurve Financial Services Limited in March 2012. Finkurve Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: HB Leasing and Finance Company Limited
Description: HB Leasing and Finance Company Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. It provides financial services, investing and dealing in various kinds of securities, loans, and guarantees. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Gurugram, India.

Name: Shricon Industries Limited
Description: Shricon Industries Limited engages in the civil works business in India. It offers engineering, heavy, and commercial construction, as well as renovation and real estate services. The company was formerly known as Bharwaney Builders and Leasing Limited and changed its name to Shricon Industries Limited in January 1995. Shricon Industries Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Kota, India.

Name: Sulabh Engineers & Services Limited
Description: Sulabh Engineers & Services Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in lending and related activities in India. The company's products include loans for business or capacity expansion, working capital loans, loans for purchase of equipment and machinery, term loans against property, loans for purchase of commercial property, and other financial services. It also provides asset financing services, which include promoter and stressed assets funding, and margin financing. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Kanpur, India.

Name: Frontier Capital Ltd
Description: Frontier Capital Limited, a non-deposit taking non-banking finance company, engages in the business of granting of loans and advances in India. The company offers vehicle, channel, and business finance; and bill discounting services. It is also involved in the financing of heavy commercial vehicles and construction equipment; hire purchase; inventory finance; factoring; and related insurance services. The company serves lower and middle-income groups; and financially underserved masses across urban, semi-urban, and rural areas in the formal and informal sectors. The company was formerly known as Frontier Leasing & Finance Ltd and changed its name to Frontier Capital Limited in July 2015. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India. Frontier Capital Limited is a subsidiary of Inimitable Capital Finance Private Limited.

Name: Navneet Education Limited
Description: Navneet Education Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in publishing state board publication books and stationery products in India, North and Central America, Africa, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Publication, Stationery, and Others segments. The Publishing segment consists of educational textbooks and supplementary materials, such as workbooks, guides, and question banks that are based on the latest prescribed syllabus by state, CBSE, and ICSE curriculums. The Stationery segment offers various products for paper and non-paper categories. The Others segment engages in the generation of power by windmill and solar panels; and trading activities. It also provides e-learning; creates digital content; and offers non-curriculum books, such as children and general books. Navneet Education Limited markets and sells its products under the Navneet, Vikas, Gala, Rise, Grafalco, and Youva brand names. The company was formerly known as Navneet Publications (India) Limited and changed its name to Navneet Education Limited in August 2013. Navneet Education Limited was founded in 1959 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: AuSom Enterprise Limited
Description: AuSom Enterprise Limited operates as trading company in India. The company trades in commodities, bullions, gold jewelry, diamonds, derivatives, shares and securities, and units of mutual funds. AuSom Enterprise Limited was formerly known as Core Emballage Limited. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Thakral Services (India) Limited
Description: Thakral Services (India) Limited provides electronic security solutions in India. The company offers surveillance systems, which comprise analog cameras, such as dome, box, speed dome, infra-red, and pin hole cameras, as well as digital video recorders; IP based systems, including network video recorders and IP cameras; and video management and video analytics software products. It also offers fire control panel, alarm systems and system components, initiators, indicating, and notifying appliances; intrusion alarm systems and system components; and access control panels and system components, as well as time and attendance, and visitor management software products. In addition, the company provides grid-tied, off-grid, and hybrid solar systems, as well as solar system components consisting of photovoltaic cells, batteries, and solar inverters. Further, it offers building management systems and accessories. Thakral Services (India) Limited serves clients in the banking and finance, information technology, healthcare, education, retail, media, utilities, and hospitality industries. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Primeast Investments Limited and changed its name to Thakral Services (India) Limited in February 2007. Thakral Services (India) Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

Name: Ruchi Infrastructure Limited
Description: Ruchi Infrastructure Limited engages in infrastructure business in India. It operates through Commodities, Infrastructure, and Others segments. The company operates liquid storage facilities for handling bulk storage of liquid commodities, such as edible oils, petroleum products, bitumen, paraffins, and liquid chemicals; and warehousing facilities, including storing agri commodities comprising wheat, maize, soybean, cotton, chana etc., as well as customized warehousing facility for various industries, such as FMCG, E-commerce, cement, white goods, soap, adhesive, paint, etc. It also trades in various commodities; operates wind energy projects; and manufactures soap. The company was formerly known as Ruchi Infrastructure and Finance Ltd and changed its name to Ruchi Infrastructure Limited in June 1995. Ruchi Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Indore, India.

Name: VJTF Eduservices Limited
Description: VJTF Eduservices Limited provides education services in India. It operates a chain of pre-schools and schools under the WITTY KIDS and WITTY INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL brand names. The company was formerly known as Artheon Finance Limited and changed its name to VJTF Eduservices Limited in March 2013. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Voltaire Leasing & Finance Limited
Description: Voltaire Leasing & Finance Limited engages in financing activities in India. The company also engages in trading and investments in equity shares. In addition, it invests in securities, commercial papers, fixed deposits, and other related activities, as well as provides corporate funding. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Netlink Solutions (India) Limited
Description: Netlink Solutions (India) Limited provides web-based and business solutions in B2B marketplace in India. It operates through four segments: Software Division, Information Media, Exhibition Management, and Treasury Management. The company organizes trade show related to corporate gifts, houseware, home décor, and novelties industries; manages exhibitions, events, conferences, and trade shows; and publishes digital magazine on corporate gifts and novelties. It also offers booth designing and fabrication services; B2B magazine and portal on corporate gifts, novelties, and stationary products; digital solutions in designing business websites; website and information technology services; and investment services. Netlink Solutions (India) Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Triliance Polymers Limited
Description: Triliance Polymers Limited engages in the manufacturing, buying, selling, indenting, trading, imports, and export of various polymers and other products in India. It also offers plastic raw materials, plastic finished products, PVC resin, melamine, unhazardous chemical products, synthetic raw materials, Di-Octyl Thelapalate and such powder of all description, petrochemical, plastic items, and other related products. The company was formerly known as Leena Consultancy Limited and changed its name to Triliance Polymers Limited in January 2023. Triliance Polymers Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Lancor Holdings Limited
Description: Lancor Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops residential and commercial properties in India. It is also involved in the leasing of commercial properties and allied activities; and provision of maintenance services. The company was formerly known as DBS Properties Limited. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: Indian Infotech and Software Limited
Description: Indian Infotech and Software Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides financing services in India. The company is involved in the provision of share trading activities; and offers loans. Indian Infotech and Software Limited was formerly known as Indian Leasers Limited and changed its name to Indian Infotech and Software Limited in July 1998. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Banas Finance Limited
Description: Banas Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in the finance and share trading activities in India. The company was formerly known as Pioneer Leasing Company Limited and changed its name to Banas Finance Limited in August 1986. Banas Finance Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Visaka Industries Limited
Description: Visaka Industries Limited manufactures and sells corrugated cement fiber sheets in India and internationally. The company operates through Building Products and Synthetic Yarn segments. It also offers cement roofing sheets, such as close-fitting adjustable ridges, apron pieces, cladding/walling, north light ridges, barge boards, north light curves, serrated adjustable ridges, roof lights, and ridge finials. In addition, the company provides V-Board, V-Premium, V-Designer, V-Plank, V-Infill, and V-Panel for various applications, such as wall paneling, dry walls, partitions, false ceilings, mezzanine flooring, roof underlay, kitchen cabinets, shelves, external cladding, sidings, façades, gates cladding, and soffits; and ATUM, an integrated solar roo?ng system. Further, it offers cotton-touch air-jet-spun polyester yarns; and mélange, twist, and specialty yarns. The company markets its building products directly to retailers and poultry farmers. Visaka Industries Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Secunderabad, India.

Name: Infomedia Press Limited
Description: Infomedia Press Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was involved in the printing business. The company was formerly known as Infomedia 18 Limited and changed its name to Infomedia Press Limited in July 2012. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Mumbai, India.Infomedia Press Limited is a subsidiary of Network18 Media & Investments Limited.

Name: Hathway Bhawani Cabletel & Datacom Limited
Description: Hathway Bhawani Cabletel & Datacom Limited provides cable television network services in India. The company offers digital cable television services. It also operates a movie-based entertainment channel under the Hathway Bhawani Cinema and Movies brand name. Hathway Bhawani Cabletel & Datacom Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Gufic Biosciences Limited
Description: Gufic Biosciences Limited manufactures and markets active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), generic pharmaceuticals, and related services in India, Africa, Asia, Europe, Australia, North America, South America, and internationally. It manufactures APIs and bulk drugs, such as antifungals, anesthetics, immuno suppressants, and intermediates for antifungals. The company also manufactures lyophilized injections, which include antibiotic, antifungal, cardiac medications, infertility treatments, antiviral solutions, and proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) segments. In addition, the company offers criti care, criticare life, ferticare, and spark pharmaceutical products; and herbal, aesthaderm, gufic stridden, and personal care products. It supplies its products to hospital chains and medical facilities. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Photon Capital Advisors Limited
Description: Photon Capital Advisors Limited provides financial and investment services in India. The company acts as an adviser to hedge funds, family offices, high net worth individuals, and investment partnerships that invest in India. It also manages proprietary funds. The company was formerly known as Hifco Marwel Limited. Photon Capital Advisors Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

Name: Not Found
Description: Oswal Leasing Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company offers leasing and hire purchase services for various types of industrial and office plants, equipment, machinery, vehicles, buildings, and real estate, as well as manufacturing, processing, transportation and trading business, and other commercial and service business. It also provides finance to industrial enterprises, as well as to companies engaged in industrial and trading business. Oswal Leasing Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Ludhiana, India.

Name: GRP Limited
Description: GRP Limited manufactures and sells reclaimed rubber products for tyre and non-tyre rubber goods in India and internationally. The company operates in Reclaim Rubber and Others segments. It offers reclaim natural and synthetic rubber products for use in inner liners and tubes, tyre side walls and piles, tyre treads and retreads, conveyor belts, moulded goods, adhesives, and footwear, as well as rubber mattings, profiles, and roofing; and POLYCOAT, an elastic powder in compounded form, which is used in NBR based molded products, metal to rubber bonded parts, NBR based oil seals, NBR matting/sheeting, and NBR-PVC blend, as well as use in tyres, conveyor belts, molded products, sheeting/matting, tread rubber, seals/gaskets, and flaps applications. The company also provides engineering plastics comprising glass filled and unfilled reprocessed nylon 6 and modified nylon 6,6 used in automotive, electrical and electronics, consumer, and industrial applications; repurposed polyolefins, such as impact copolymer polypropylene, IC PP custom colors, and PP based elastomers used in paint and lubricant pails, automotive battery covers, and pallets; and custom die forms consisting of link, door, and industrial mats, as well as dock bumpers primarily for use in civil and agricultural applications. In addition, it generates power from windmill; offers polymer composite products, including boards, wheel chocks, and assembled products used in logistics, construction, oil and gas, aviation, marine, industrial, and agriculture applications; and develops poly-blends and thermoplastic elastomers. The company was formerly known as Gujarat Reclaim and Rubber Products Limited and changed its name to GRP Limited in June 2012. GRP Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Indag Rubber Limited
Description: Indag Rubber Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells precured tread rubber and allied products in India. It offers precured tread rubber, bonding repair and extrusion gum, and rubber cement. The company also provides consulting services, including retreading process and machinery consultancy, and troubleshooting. Indag Rubber Limited was incorporated in 1978 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: M M Rubber Company Limited
Description: M M Rubber Company Limited manufactures and markets foam and other related products primarily in India. The company provides organic latex mattress, latex hybrid mattress, and foam mattresses; latex pillows, latex hybrid pillows, and polyfibre pillows; accessories, such as mattress protector and topper, travel pillow, and coccyx and haemorrhoid cushions; and luxury bus, aircraft seats, and upholstery sheeting products. It offers its products under the MM FOAM brand. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

Name: PTL Enterprises Limited
Description: PTL Enterprises Limited leases of plant to Apollo Tyres Limited. The company was formerly known as Premier Tyres Ltd. PTL Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1959 and is based in Gurugram, India. PTL Enterprises Limited is a subsidiary of Sunrays Properties & Investment Co. Pvt. Ltd.

Name: TVS Srichakra Limited
Description: TVS Srichakra Limited manufactures and sells two-wheeler, three-wheeler, and other industrial tires to original equipment and vehicle manufacturers in India. The company provides ultra light truck, agricultural, OTR, and automotive tires, tubes, and flaps. It also offers farm and implement, skid steer, and multipurpose tires, as well as steel belted agri radials and flotation tires. The company serves its products through a network of depots, distributors, and retailers. It also exports its products. TVS Srichakra Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Madurai, India.

Name: Sanathnagar Enterprises Limited
Description: Sanathnagar Enterprises Limited engages in the real estate development business in India. The company was formerly known as Bakelite Hylam Limited. Sanathnagar Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Mumbai, India. The company is a subsidiary of Macrotech Developers Limited.

Name: Benares Hotels Limited
Description: Benares Hotels Limited operates hotels in India. It operates hotels under the Taj Ganges and Taj Nadesar Palace names in Varanasi; and The Ginger Hotel name in Gondia. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India. Benares Hotels Limited operates as a subsidiary of The Indian Hotels Company Limited.

Name: Bhagawati Oxygen Limited
Description: Bhagawati Oxygen Limited manufactures and supplies industrial gases in India. It operates through Gases and Power segments. The company offers oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide, dissolved acetylene, hydrogen, helium, and compressed air for use in industrial applications, such as smelting, steelmaking, semiconductor, fertilizer, oil refineries, etc.; and electronic grade and commercial grade gases, gas mixtures, and calibration gases. It also builds and operates various on-site gas production plants for the production of oxygen, nitrogen, argon, etc.; and designs and sells gas handling and distribution systems. In addition, the company offers turnkey contracting solutions, including design, engineering, and construction of air separation plants, cross-country gas pipeline systems, cryogenic liquid storage and gas handling systems, etc. Further, the company generates and supplies wind power. Bhagawati Oxygen Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Ballabhgarh, India.

Name: Bombay Oxygen Investments Limited
Description: Bombay Oxygen Investments Limited operates as a non-banking financial institution in India. It invests in mutual funds and other financial instruments, as well as various listed equities. The company was formerly known as Bombay Oxygen Corporation Limited and changed its name to Bombay Oxygen Investments Limited in October 2018. Bombay Oxygen Investments Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Cravatex Limited
Description: Cravatex Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in branded sports goods, wellness, and fitness equipment trading businesses in India and internationally. It is involved in designing, sourcing, and marketing as a licensee of the Fila and Sergio Tacchini brand. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Cravatex Limited is a subsidiary of R.B. Fitness and Trading Private Limited.

Name: Berger Paints India Limited
Description: Berger Paints India Limited manufactures and sells paints for home, professional, and industrial users in India and internationally. The company offers interior wall coatings, including designer finishes, interior emulsions, and ceiling paints; exterior wall coatings comprising exterior emulsions and textures, and roof and floor coatings; specialty industrial coatings; putty and cement paints; solvent, interior, exterior, metal, and wood primers; waterproofing solutions; wood finishes; enamels; aerosol spray paints, and DIY kits and stickers. It also provides automotive, fireproof, protective, floor, and powder coatings; road markings; construction chemicals, flooring compounds, bitumen and coal tar-based products, sealants and adhesives, and anti-corrosive coatings; lacquers; and various sanitization products. In addition, the company offers acrylic, silicate, and mineral plasters; thermal insulation adhesives; mortars; ready to use coat, wood effect, ribbed effect, concrete effect, and 3D effect panels; gel adhesives; and coil coating solutions. The company was formerly known as British Paints (India) Limited and changed its name to Berger Paints India Limited in December 1983. The company was incorporated in 1923 and is based in Kolkata, India. Berger Paints India Limited is a subsidiary of U. K. Paints India Private Limited.

Name: Caprihans India Limited
Description: Caprihans India Limited engages in the pharmaceutical packaging business in India and internationally. The company offers rigid and flexible polyvinyl chloride (PVC) films, polyvinylidene chloride (PVDC) coated films, plastic extruded products, alu alu foils, and other products. It also provides blister films under the Duplex, Triplex, Ultra, Ultra Tx, Armour, Aclar, Excel, Exxtra, Optra, and BAPP names; blister foils under the Venus, Venus PR, Venus SBC, Tropical Foil, Nutra Venus, and Vento Venus names; lidding foils under the Zeon, Zeon+, Zenith, Zeon+PR, Suppo Zenith, and Zeon PR names; cr foils under the Crispak AP-PT, Crispak PP, Crispak PL, and Crispak PT names; and laminates under the Lamiflex name. In addition, the company offers pharma packaging research services, including formulation stability studies, blister / foil design and development, pharma brand innovation, analytical research and market study, and packaging trials and audit services. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Pune, India. Caprihans India Limited is a subsidiary of Bilcare Mauritius Limited.

Name: Graphite India Limited
Description: Graphite India Limited manufactures and sells graphite electrodes, and carbon and graphite specialty products in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Graphite and Carbon, and Others. It offers a range of graphite electrodes with various diameter and power for AC and DC furnaces. The company also provides extruded graphite in the form of rods and blocks, mini rods, graphite tubes, heat exchanger tubes, molded mold and isostatically molded graphite, machined components of carbon and graphite, carbon graphite/bricks, and carbon composites/brake discs. In addition, it offers calcined petroleum coke, carbon electrode paste, graphite granules and fines, and carbonaceous materials to aluminum, steel, ferro alloy, and foundry castings industries; and impervious graphite heat exchangers, which are used as condensers, coolers, heaters, re-boilers, evaporators, interchangers, and graphite columns for distillation, absorption and scrubbing, ejector systems, and centrifugal pumps. Further, the company provides HCl synthesis, dry HCl gas generation units, absorber/absorption system for HCI, HF, and HBr, and H2SO4/HCl concentration and acid dilution cooling units; bursting/rupture discs, pipes, and pipe fittings; glass fiber reinforced plastic pipes, joints, and fittings; and high speed, alloy tool, and powder metallurgy steels for cutting tools. Additionally, it generates and sells electricity through a hydel power plant. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India. Graphite India Limited is a subsidiary of The Emerald Company Ltd.

Name: ITD Cementation India Limited
Description: ITD Cementation India Limited provides construction and civil engineering contracting services in India. The company constructs maritime structures, including jetties, dolphins, service platforms, quay, berths on concrete and steel piles, solid gravity type wharf structures, ship lifts, dry docks, wet basins, and inclined berths; and offers breakwater and piled approach trestles, steel piles and bored casts, undersea ground improvement, dredging and land reclamation, and coastal erosion protection and rock bund services. It also constructs highways, bridges, and flyovers; tunnels and airports; hydroelectric and irrigation projects comprising pumping stations, power houses, tunnels, intake structures, pressure shafts, and penstock pipes; mass rapid transit systems; and dams, buildings, and industrial structures. In addition, the company offers foundation and specialist engineering services comprising geotechnical investigations, piling, diaphragm walling, slope stabilization, sandwicks/band drains, vibrofloatation stone columns, drilling and grouting, rock/soil anchors repairs, colcrete, gunite/shotcrete, grouted mattress, box pushing, tube heading, microtunneling, and rehabilitation and underpinning services. Further, it engages in the civil works for refinery, petrochemical, power, steel, and fertilizer plants; design, construction, supply, installation, and commissioning of pipelines; and operation of water and wastewater treatment plants, and pumping stations. The company serves state and central government departments, ministries, local municipal bodies, and private clients. The company was formerly known as Skanska Cementation India Limited and changed its name to ITD Cementation India Limited in May 2005. ITD Cementation India Limited was founded in 1931 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Empire Industries Limited
Description: Empire Industries Limited engages in the manufacture of container glass, trading of frozen foods, and indenting and property development businesses in India and internationally. The company manufacture and sells amber glass bottles for the pharmaceutical industry. It offers heavy-duty and high precision portal milling machines, mill turn centers, high precision five axis machining centers, horizontal boring machines, gear cutting machines, grinding machines for cylindrical and profile applications, center less grinding machines, special application grinding centers, and high precision and profile broaching machines for defense, aerospace and aircraft, railways, heavy engineering, automobile, energy and power, tool rooms, steel, fabricators, and machine tools manufacturers. In addition, the company provides consultancy services to steel, oil and gas, ports and shipyards, packaged solutions for fuel storage tanks and terminals, fire & safety equipment and systems, SMART CITY initiatives, renewable power, and water and waste management industries. Further, it is involved in providing vending machines that offer snacks, beverages, perishables, stationery, coins, sanitary pads, personal care products, and PPE's under the GRABBIT+ brand; markets and distributes frozen and chilled food, including marine foods and meat products to hotels, restaurants, and catering and retail chains; builds and manages flexible and customized furnished offices, and meeting and conference room facilities, as well as provides business support services; owns commercial properties and IT spaces; and develops property for micro, small, and medium enterprises, and residential complexes. The company was incorporated in 1900 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Graviss Hospitality Limited
Description: Graviss Hospitality Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the hospitality business in India. It owns and operates a hotel under the Inter-Continental at Marine Drive, Mumbai. The company was formerly known as The GL Hotels Limited and changed its name to Graviss Hospitality Limited in July 2008. Graviss Hospitality Limited was incorporated in 1959 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Garware Technical Fibres Limited
Description: Garware Technical Fibres Limited manufactures and sells various technical textile products in India and internationally. It operates through Synthetic Cordage and Fibre and Industrial Products and Projects segments. The company provides smolt and grow out cages, predator cages, mooring and vertical ropes, lice shields; bottom and pelagic trawling, gill netting, pure sein, dol, crab/lobster fishing nets; and insect nets, anti-hail, anti-birds, grape, crop support, floriculture, fencing, BLRS nets, as shade net, staking cord, seed protection cage, and weed mat. It offers coated fabrics products comprising of decorative fabrics, bouncies, sports, water tank/bio flock, bio gas, and shelter fabrics; transport and heat management solutions; mooring, towing, and other rope articles and accessories; UHMPE products; and single point mooring systems; air inflatable tents, recovery /under slung, and fast rope; fire retardant/ vehicle, muzzle, and gun covers; sport net, sport frames and accessories, safety/protection nets, fitness and mountaineering ropes, and customized products comprising wood carrying bags, and hay, cargo, and helicopter landing nets; and transmission, submersible, and other general applications ropes. In addition, it offers bag closing, doll hair, jute bag stitching products; fall protection solutions; geo synthesis solutions for environment, highways and railways, erosion control, mining, oil, gas, and energy, slope protection, coastal and river protection nets; and lifting solutions, such as lifting and round slings, and cut and abrasion resistant sleeves. The company was formerly known as Garware-Wall Ropes Limited and changed its name to Garware Technical Fibres Limited in July 2018. Garware Technical Fibres Limited was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Pune, India.

Name: Garware Marine Industries Limited
Description: Garware Marine Industries Limited engages in the provision of ship repair services in India. The company's services comprise pump overhauls, engine overhaul/repairs, hydraulic and gear box repair, and pipeline and other marine fabrication jobs. It also assists OEM engineers in day dockings, shaft removal and renewal, propeller hub overhaul, bow thruster, and stern thruster overhauls. The company was formerly known as Modern Nets Limited and changed its name to Garware Marine Industries Limited in December 1981. Garware Marine Industries Limited was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Goa Carbon Limited
Description: Goa Carbon Limited manufactures, markets, and sells calcined petroleum coke in India. It serves aluminum, graphite, electrode, foundry, glass, carbon paste, steel, titanium dioxide, metallurgical, and chemical industries. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Panaji, India. Goa Carbon Limited operates as a subsidiary of V. S. Dempo Holdings Private Limited.

Name: Hardcastle and Waud Manufacturing Company Limited
Description: Hardcastle and Waud Manufacturing Company Limited engages in the trading of industrial chemicals in India. The company operates through Industrial Chemicals, Investing, and Leasing segments. It is also involved in investment and leasing activities. Hardcastle and Waud Manufacturing Company Limited was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: HEG Limited
Description: HEG Limited manufactures and sells graphite electrodes in India and internationally. The company operates through Graphite Electrodes and Power Generation segments. It provides ultra-high power and high power electrodes; graphite electrodes and nipples; carbon blocks; graphite specialties; and activated carbon fabric products. The company operates thermal power plants and a hydroelectric power facility. HEG Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Noida, India.

Name: Hindustan Composites Limited
Description: Hindustan Composites Limited develops, manufactures, and markets fibre based friction materials in India. Its friction materials include automotive brake linings, automotive and industrial roll linings, automotive clutch facings and ceramic buttons, automotive disc brake pads, railway brake blocks, and friction sheets. The company also provides industrial thrust bearing and insulation products comprising millboard sheets, millboard discs, compestos, and compestos rings. It serves various industries, such as automotive, railways, engineering, mining, aerospace, steel, chemical, oil exploration, etc. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: The Indian Card Clothing Company Limited
Description: The Indian Card Clothing Company Limited manufactures and sells card clothing in India. It operates through Card Clothing and Realty segments. The company's products include cotton and synthetic products, such as cylinder wires, doffer wires, lickerin wires, and flat tops; metallic wires for non-woven cards; woolen, sundry, and fancy fillets; and rasing fillets and brush sheets for various fibres, yarn rasing fillets, humbugs, and hand cleaning cards. It also provides Accura carding systems for ERM and RSK; Accura carding elements; and XTRAC systems; and card room machinery, including TOPS height measurement and re-sharpening, wire re- sharpening, roller mounting, and clipit machines. It also exports its products. The Indian Card Clothing Company Limited was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Pune, India. The Indian Card Clothing Company Limited is a subsidiary of Multi Act Industrial Enterprises Limited.

Name: International Conveyors Limited
Description: International Conveyors Limited manufactures and markets PVC conveyor belting products in India and internationally. It operates through Conveyor Belting, Wind Energy, Trading Goods, and Investment segments. The company offers mineplast fire-resistant belting for conveying coal, potash, phosphate, fertilizer, clay, gypsum, and salt, as well as in timber industry applications. It is also involved in the trading of ply conveyor belting, steel cord conveyor belting, and fitting and accessories; generation, supply, and sale of wind power; and investment activities. International Conveyors Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Kolkata, India.

Name: Modern Shares and Stockbrokers Limited
Description: Modern Shares and Stockbrokers Limited provides stock broking services in India. The company offers retail broking services, including the purchase and sale of securities that comprise equity and derivative instruments; technical research/analysis services; and advisory services, as well as distributes mutual funds. It also provides Market Wizard, a bi-monthly newsletter. The company was formerly known as Modern Home Credit & Capital Ltd. Modern Shares and Stockbrokers Limited was incorporated in 1939 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Huhtamaki India Limited
Description: Huhtamaki India Limited manufactures and sells of flexible consumer packaging and labelling solutions in India. It provides flexible packaging materials, pouches, and label for food and beverages, coffee, petfood, barrier protection, retort applications, healthcare, and industrial markets. The company also offers labels, including anti-counterfeit solutions, such as transfer, tamper-proof seal, backside printing and numbering, variable data, and hologram labels; functional labels comprising hanger, reclosable, braille, high and low-temperature resistant labels, and squeezable wrinkle-free labels for tubes and pouches; dome, metallic gold and silver printed, digital printed, tactile labels, and ultra-clear films; two and three-layer, and booklet labels; and shrink sleeves, and low migration and in-mould labels. In addition, it involves in laser engraving; supply of engraved cylinders; and offers mono-material products under the blueloop brand name. The company was formerly known as Huhtamaki PPL Limited and changed its name to Huhtamaki India Limited in November 2020. Huhtamaki India Limited was founded in 1935 and is based in Thane, India. Huhtamaki India Limited operates as a subsidiary of Huhtavefa BV.

Name: Premier Synthetics Limited
Description: Premier Synthetics Limited trades in cotton and cotton yarn in India. The company was formerly known as Premier Synthetics and Processors Ltd. Premier Synthetics Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.

Name: R. J. Shah & Company Limited
Description: R. J. Shah & Company Limited constructs small and medium size hydroelectric project with EPC contract or civil works with hydro mechanical works in India. The company is primarily involved in the underground works of tunnels, cavern shafts, inclined tunnels with government and semi-government or various electricity boards, railways, atomic power stations, irrigation, etc. and work receipts. R.J. Shah & Company Limited was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Shalimar Paints Limited
Description: Shalimar Paints Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of paints and coatings in India and internationally. It offers decorative paints for interior and exterior surfaces, concrete, plasters, metals etc.; and marine coatings for antifouling paint of boats, fishing trawlers, and other ground marine structures. The company also provides emulsions, enamels, distemper, primer, epoxy, pipeline, protective, can, aluminum, and zinc rich coatings, as well as putty, cement-based, finishes, floors, and waterproofing paint products. It offers its products under the Signature, Weather PRO+, Hero, and XTRA TOUGH brand names. In addition, the company also provides a tinting systems under the Color Space brand name. Shalimar Paints Limited was incorporated in 1902 and is based in Gurugram, India.

Name: Sinnar Bidi Udyog Limited
Description: Sinnar Bidi Udyog Limited processes and trades tobacco in India. Sinnar Bidi Udyog Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Nasik, India.

Name: Hindoostan Mills Limited
Description: Hindoostan Mills Limited manufactures and sells textile products in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Textile and Engineering. The company offers open end yarns; and greige and processed fabrics. It manufactures and supplies calendar bowls, calendaring machines, squeeze rolls, and related products for the textile, paper, and steel industries. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Sirdar Carbonic Gas Company Ltd. and changed its name to Hindoostan Mills Limited in May 2011. Hindoostan Mills Limited was founded in 1873 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: The Supreme Industries Limited
Description: The Supreme Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of plastic products in India. The company offers plastic piping systems, including uPVC pipes, injection-molded PVC and handmade fittings; polypropylene random co-polymer pipe systems; HDPE and CPVC pipe systems; inspection chambers; manholes; bath fittings and sanitaryware; roto-molded tanks and fittings; solvents; industrial piping systems; DWC and PEX Pe pipe systems; and fire sprinkler systems. It also provides industrial products, such as industrial components, material handling system and pallets, roto moulded crates, pallets, and garbage bins and composite LPG cylinders. In addition, the company provides packaging products comprising flexible packaging film products, protective packaging products, and cross-laminated film and products; and furniture. It also exports its products. The Supreme Industries Limited was incorporated in 1942 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Thacker and Company Limited
Description: Thacker and Company Limited engages in the real estate and other financial businesses in India. It operates through Investment & Finance, Business Centre, and Trading Business segments. The company provides real estate services with owned or leased properties; and trades in scanners and related products. Thacker and Company Limited was incorporated in 1878 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: U.P. Hotels Limited
Description: U.P. Hotels Limited owns and operates hotels in India. It offers accommodation and venues for weddings, events, conventions, conference, banquet, party, business meetings, and other services under the Clarks brand name in Agra, Jaipur, Lucknow, and Khajuraho. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

Name: VST Industries Limited
Description: VST Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing, trading, and marketing of cigarettes, tobacco, and tobacco products in India and internationally. It also sells unmanufactured tobacco. The company was formerly known as Vazir Sultan Tobacco Company Limited and changed its name to VST Industries Limited in April 1983. VST Industries Limited was incorporated in 1930 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

Name: Swasti Vinayaka Synthetics Limited
Description: Swasti Vinayaka Synthetics Limited manufactures and sells suiting, shirting, and other apparel products in India. The company offers a range of shirting fabrics, including cotton, linen, lycra, polyester, viscose, and their blends. It also provides its uniform fabrics to corporate and government institutions. In addition, the company designs bridal and formal ethnic wear under the Ivy League brand; and supplies salwar kameez and tunics. It markets its products through a network of agents/dealers, as well as directly to retail chains, the RMG sector, garment exporters, clothing brands, and corporate houses. The company was formerly known as Rajesh Synthetics Ltd. and changed its name to Swasti Vinayaka Synthetics Limited in September 1999. Swasti Vinayaka Synthetics Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: MSL Global Limited
Description: Madhusudan Securities Limited engages in the investment business in India. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Yamini Investments Company Limited
Description: Yamini Investments Company Limited engages in the investment business in India. The company is involved in the investment activities through capital, loan, equity participation, and financial assistance. Yamini Investments Company Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Premier Capital Services Limited
Description: Premier Capital Services Limited manufactures, trades, and finances dairy products in India. The company offers milk, skimmed milk powder, ghee, butter, cheese, etc. Premier Capital Services Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Indore, India.

Name: Milgrey Finance and Investments Limited
Description: Milgrey Finance and Investments Limited engages in dealing in IT products in India. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Jindal Drilling & Industries Limited
Description: Jindal Drilling & Industries Limited provides drilling and related services to the oil and gas exploration companies in India. It provides offshore drilling, horizontal and directional drilling, measurement while drilling, and mud logging services. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

Name: Sakthi Finance Limited
Description: Sakthi Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides asset financing services in India. It is involved in the provision of hire purchase financing of commercial vehicles, infrastructure equipment, machineries, interest rates and charges, consumer education literature, etc. The company offers non-convertible debentures, fixed and cumulative income deposits, and subordinated bonds. It operates through a network of branches located in Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, and Puducherry. Sakthi Finance Limited was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Coimbatore, India.

Name: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited
Description: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells stainless-steel flexible hoses and assemblies in India and internationally. It offers corrugated stainless steel, double interlock flexible metal, and composite hoses, as well as stainless steel hose assemblies. The company also manufactures and sells flexible intermediate bulk containers, polypropylene (PP), high density polyethylene (HDPE) bags, and BOPP laminated bags, as well as PP/HDPE woven fabrics and stainless steel wire rods; offers SME and business, working capital, and consumer loans; and hydraulic fittings, fluid connectors, and flanges. Further, the company invests in various sectors, including food-tech, ed-tech, e-commerce, hyper-local services, fin-tech, D2C, web3 and blockchain, SaaS, IoT, EV, robotics, engineering, space tech, agri-tech, gaming, refurbishment, holistic wellness, and others. The company exports its products to the Middle East, Europe, Africa, Asia, Caribbean, the United States, and Australia. The company was formerly known as Sat Industries Limited and changed its name to Aeroflex Enterprises Limited in May 2025. Aeroflex Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: JMD Ventures Limited
Description: JMD Ventures Limited engages in the entertainment, digital, e-commerce, education, distribution, retail, investment, infrastructure, media, trading, and service sectors in India. The company is involved in the online retail of musical instruments and pro audio equipment through bajaao.com; import and sale of mobile devices, handsets, and accessories under the JMD brand; and provision of audio/video file conversion, learning, and e-commerce mobile value-added services. It also engages in video/film, on-location video, studio video, and post production; sound, live, on-location, and studio recording; sound mixing and effects; auditorium and acoustic design; and acoustic panel-based studio design and development activities. In addition, the company provides internet and e-commerce solutions; and funding and investment services to entrepreneurs and businesses, as well as operates a music school and an e-learning platform. Further, it engages in provision of media courses; music and commercial TV content production; content development for applications; investing in shares and other securities; and commodities and other related activities of capital markets. The company was formerly known as JMD Telefilms Industries Limited and changed its name to JMD Ventures Limited. JMD Ventures Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: V. B. Desai Financial Services Limited
Description: V. B. Desai Financial Services Limited provides merchant banking and advisory services in India. The company's merchant banking services include the management of public IPOs and open offers; rights issue, offer for sale, and qualified institutional placements; and buy-backs and delisting services. It provides merger and acquisition services, including preparing pitch documents/information memorandums, performing valuations on targets, and calculating acquisition synergies for the acquirer, and engineering and advisory services for deals and new deals; strategic partnership services; and corporate advisory services in the areas of capital/debt structuring, preparing project reports/appraisals, devising financial structures, spin-offs, structuring leveraged buy outs, and compliance related issues; and valuation services for ESOPs, regulatory purposes, fairness opinions, and business and IP valuation. In addition, the company offers advisory services in raising equity through venture capital activities, private equity and quasi equity placements, strategic investments by corporates, and secondary market offerings/placements; and advisory services in raising debt from banks, financial institutions, and international/multilateral organizations through long term/short term working capital funding, foreign currency borrowings/external commercial borrowings, project financing, and convertible debt. It serves heavy engineering, information technology, cement, pharmaceutical, hotel, chemical, power, and oil and gas industries. The company was formerly known as Alpha Financial & Advisory Services Limited and changed its name to V. B. Desai Financial Services Limited in September 1985. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Quadrant Televentures Limited
Description: Quadrant Televentures Limited provides telecommunication services to enterprise and retail customers under the CONNECT brand name in India. The company offers voice telephony, internet, and broadband data services. It also offers value-added services, such as Centrex, leased lines, VPNs, voicemail, etc. Quadrant Televentures Limited was formerly known as HFCL Infotel Limited and changed its name to Quadrant Televentures Limited in September 2010. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Mohali, India.

Name: The First Custodian Fund (I) Ltd.
Description: The First Custodian Fund (India) Ltd. provides securities brokerage services in India. The company also deals/invests in shares and securities, as well as trades in futures and options. The First Custodian Fund (India) Ltd. was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Kamanwala Housing Construction Limited
Description: Kamanwala Housing Construction Limited engages in the real estate development business in India. It is involved in the construction and development of residential and commercial buildings, and related activities. The company was formerly known as Kamanwala Industries Limited and changed its name to Kamanwala Housing Construction Limited in December 2006. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: WSFx Global Pay Limited
Description: WSFx Global Pay Limited, a financial services company, engages in foreign exchange business in India. It provides forex prepaid cards, outward remittance services, and currency exchange facilities to corporate and leisure travelers, students, and millennials. The company also offers outward remittance services for students to pay university fees to pursue education abroad; cross border remittance business; and personal remittances for tours, medical treatment, and other permissible transactions.
