In addition, it provides platforms and products under the WSFx name, such as Global pay app and web portal, which includes forex, travel-related services, and to place orders vis online A2 form submission; Smart corporate platform, a digital solution to aid corporates with forex requirements for business travel; Smart agent platform, a digital solution for agent partners to manage forex and remittance requirements; Global pay platform, a plug and play forex platform as a service solution for agent, agent partners, education institutions, and students; and Smart currency card, a multi-currency forex and INR card. Further, the company offers Thomas Cook prepaid cards, including borderless prepaid and one currency cards; currency notes; international student identity card; travel insurance plans; and guaranteed investment certificate and blocked accounts. It operates through its digital platforms and branches. The company was formerly known as Wall Street Finance Limited and changed its name to WSFx Global Pay Limited in December 2022. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. WSFx Global Pay Limited is a subsidiary of Spice Connect Private Limited.

Name: Anjani Foods Limited
Description: Anjani Foods Limited engages in the production and sale of bakery products in India. The company operates through Retail, and Distribution and Modern Trade segments. It offers bakery products, savouries, desserts, cakes, and beverages under the Fresh Choice brand name, as well as operates retail outlets. In addition, the company offers pastries, pizzas, pastas, and sandwiches through its patisserie cafes. It provides its products through distribution networks. The company was formerly known as Raasi Enterprises Limited and changed its name to Anjani Foods Limited in November 2014. Anjani Foods Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

Name: RKD Agri & Retail Limited
Description: RKD Agri & Retail Limited engages in the wholesale and retail trade of bags, and printing and stationery products in India. It is also involved in agriculture and allied activities. The company was formerly known as Himalchuli Food Products Limited and changed its name to RKD Agri & Retail Limited in September 2020. RKD Agri & Retail Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Parshwanath Corporation Limited
Description: Parshwanath Corporation Limited engages in the construction and development of housing and commercial projects in India. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Not Found
Description: Rajvi Logitrade Limited provides transportation and logistics services. The company offers port operation services comprising of bagging, rake and barge handling, cargo handling, stevedoring, and warehousing services. It also offers transportation services consisting of break bulk cargo, steel, container, project cargo, liquid, material handling, and bulk cargo services. In addition, the company provides custom solutions including import/export, container, exim advising, air cargo, and bonded warehousing solutions. Further, it offers vessel agency, chartering, and survey services; freight forwarding services, as well as provides shipping and route mapping solutions. Additionally, the company provides various infrastructure services for trucks, trailers, tippers, dumpers, bulkers, pay loaders, excavators, hydraulic hoppers, and mobile cranes. The company was formerly known as Suryakrupa Finance Limited and changed its name to Rajvi Logitrade Limited in May 2023. Rajvi Logitrade Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Gandhidham, India.

Name: Millennium Online Solutions (India) Limited
Description: Millennium Online Solutions (India) Limited engages in the provision of various services relating to computer hardware and its peripherals India. The company was formerly known as Mahamaya Investments Limited and changed its name to Millennium Online Solutions (India) Limited in June 2013. Millennium Online Solutions (India) Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Surat, India.

Name: ICDS Limited
Description: ICDS Limited engages in trading shares and securities, and mobiles and accessories in India. It also engages in the rental of investment properties; and marketing of life and general insurance products. The company was formerly known as Industrial Credit and Development Syndicate Ltd. and changed its name to ICDS Limited in December 1992. ICDS Limited was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Manipal, India.

Name: Can Fin Homes Limited
Description: Can Fin Homes Limited provides housing finance services primarily to individuals, builders, corporates, and others in India. The company's products portfolio comprises housing loans, such as individual housing loans, affordable housing loans, credit link subsidy scheme and Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY), composite loans, and top-up loans; and non-housing loans, including mortgage loans, site loans, loans for commercial properties, loans against rent receivables, personal loans, loans for children education, and loans for pensioners, as well as fixed and cumulative deposits. Can Fin Homes Limited operates various branches, housing loan centers, and satellite offices. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

Name: Munoth Capital Market Limited
Description: Munoth Capital Market Limited engages in the depository participation and share brokerage activities in India. It offers a range of alternative and traditional investment strategies for institutions, private investors, and individuals. The company also provides advice based broking desk that monitors portfolio; hedge fund services; margin funding services; and depository services that handles securities transactions. Munoth Capital Market Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: IL&FS Investment Managers Limited
Description: IL&FS Investment Managers Limited is a private equity, venture capital, infrastructure and real estate investment firm specializing in seed capital, late venture, growth capital, expansions, middle market, restructuring, stressed assets, recapitalizations, buyouts investments, and real estate investments in high-growth real estate assets including office, residential, retail, integrated townships, special economic zones, hospitality, and mixed-use properties. It also makes debt investments as well as investment banking led private equity transactions focused on opportunities arising from stressed assets. The firm seeks to invest in energy, materials, logistics, agricultural services, auto components, textiles, healthcare, power, waste management, toll roads and cable infrastructure, biotechnology, niche manufacturing, retail, media, consumer services, consumer brands, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, airport services, highways and rail tracks, marine ports and services, infrastructure and related services, telecom, city gas distribution, shipyards, life sciences, real estate, waste water treatment, information technology, and information technology enabled services sectors. It seeks to invest in Middle East, Asian markets with a focus on India, Tamil Nadu, and Delhi; and China. It seeks to equity investment between $1 million and $50 million in companies with market capitalization of $50 million and $150 million. The firm prefers to make seed capital funding in infrastructure projects in the range of $2 million and $10 million. In the real estate sector, it seeks to invest between $20 million and $50 million. The firm seeks to hold its investments for a period between three years and five years. It seeks to make private equity investments in post revenue companies. The firm prefers to take a seat on the board of directors of its portfolio companies. IL&FS Investment Managers Limited was founded in 1989 and is based in Mumbai, India. It operates as a subsidiary of Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services Limited

Name: Shriram Finance Limited
Description: Shriram Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides financing services in India. It offers fixed and recurring deposits; commercial vehicle loans for commercial goods vehicles, passenger commercial vehicles, tractors and farm equipment, and construction equipment; two-wheeler, gold, used car loan, and personal loans; and green finance services. The company also provides business loans, such as MSME loans; working capital loans, including tyre, tax, fuel, toll financing, repair/top-up loans, fuel finance, and challan discounting; motor insurance, including four-wheeler, two-wheeler, passenger and goods carrying vehicle insurance products; non motor insurance products, such as personal accident, shri criti care, and home insurance; and life insurance products comprising savings, retirement, child, protection plans, as well as recharges, including mobile recharge, mobile postpaid, landline postpaid, DTH, and FASTag recharge services. In addition, it offers utilities and bills payment services, such as electricity, LPG gas, gas, broadband postpaid, water, and cable tv; financial services and taxes comprising credit card, loan repayment, insurance, municipal services, and recurring deposit; and other services, such as hospital and pathology, housing society, clubs and associations, and education fees. It serves first time buyers, small road transport operators, individuals, micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), salaried professionals, and self-employed individuals. The company was formerly known as Shriram Transport Finance Company Limited and changed its name to Shriram Finance Limited in November 2022. Shriram Finance Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited
Description: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited, operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company operates through Vehicle Finance, Loan Against Property, Home Loans, and Other Loans segments. It offers loans for commercial vehicles, passenger vehicles, two- and three- wheelers, and tractors, as well as construction equipment. The company also provides secured loans against property, and home and SME loans, as well as consumer and small enterprise loans, including personal loans, professional loans, and business loans to salaried, self-employed professional and non-professional customers, and micro and small businesses. In addition, it offers portfolio management services, such as investment solutions to individual clients; stock broking services to retail and institutional investors; and distributes insurance products and mutual funds. Further, the company provides dealer portal services under the Gaadi Bazaar brand, that acts as a hub for dealers in listing vehicles, generating leads, and applying for loans and trade advances. Additionally, it operates Payswiff, an omni channel payment transaction solution that lets business owners accept payments from their customers in-store, at home deliveries, online and on-the-go using mPOS and POS solutions. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: Bombay Talkies Ltd
Description: Bombay Talkies Limited primarily engages in production of movies/serials/soap opera for TV/OTT platform, etc. in India. It also provides consultancy on various subject related to film/serial/video albums, etc. The company was formerly known as White Lion Asia Limited and changed its name to Bombay Talkies Limited in September 2002. Bombay Talkies Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: VLS Finance Limited
Description: VLS Finance Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides stock broking services in India. The company is involved in the investment and sale/purchase of shares/securities and derivatives. It also provides proprietary investments and equity research; and corporate consulting and advisory services. In addition, the company offers investment banking services, such as determination of the issue size and pricing; drafting of the offer document and filling the same with the authorities for approval; co-ordination with various regulatory authorities and private agencies during the issue; chalking out a successful strategy for marketing of the issue; and selection of the right market timing. VLS Finance Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: India Cements Capital Limited
Description: India Cements Capital Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of money changing services under the For X Change brand name in India. The company buys and sells foreign currency notes in retail, as well as wholesale to individuals and corporate clients; offers outward telegraphic remittances, including outbound remittances towards overseas education and student fees, tour remittances, medical treatment abroad, and for other permissible purposes; and involved in money transfer and forex prepaid card business. It also offers advisory services on the forex market for exporters and importers under the Midas Advisory brand name; travel related services, such as ticketing, hotel bookings, visa processing, etc.; and share broking services. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: Ad-Manum Finance Limited
Description: Ad-Manum Finance Limited engages in the non-banking finance business in India. The company operates through Wind Power Generation and Finance segments. It offers short-term loans; and generates electricity through windmills. The company was formerly known as Agarwal Warehousing & Leasing Limited and changed its name to Ad-Manum Finance Limited in June 1992. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Indore, India.

Name: Mehta Integrated Finance Limited
Description: Mehta Integrated Finance Limited, a financial services company, engages in capital market investment and consulting activities in India. The company provides corporate advisory in merger and amalgamation, investment and corporate advisory, SME listing, initial public offering, and further public offerings, as well as in fund raising, equity and debt private placements, and capital restructuring. It offers merchant banking services, including follow on public offers, valuation, buy back, take over/open offer, right issues, delisting, direct listing, corporate finance, private equity, credit rating advisory, and ESOP schemes and certification. In addition, the company offers lead manager services, valuation report of corporates, banker to an issue, and underwriting services. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Inter Globe Finance Limited
Description: Inter Globe Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides various financial services in India. The company offers micro, small, and medium enterprise/small and medium enterprise finance; loan syndication; project finance; ECB/ICDs; IPO funding; loan against property and shares; mortgages; construction/infrastructure/medical/IT/equipment finance; and working capital, two wheeler, and business loans. Inter Globe Finance Limited provides financial management and advisory services. The company serves share broking houses, logistics, integrated steel plants, real estate developers, infrastructure conglomerates, airport ground handling services, retail marts, and iron ore mine industries, as well as the power sector. Inter Globe Finance Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

Name: Munoth Communication Limited
Description: Munoth Communication Limited sells and distributes mobile phones and accessories in India. The company offers power banks, chargers, cables, tempered glasses, and other products. Munoth Communication Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: Shristi Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited
Description: Shristi Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction and infrastructure development business in India. The company constructs roads, power plants, townships, and other infrastructure projects. It is also involved in construction of premium residential, hotels, hospitals, mixed use development properties, shopping malls, logistics hubs, economic and industrial parks, and other infrastructure projects. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Kolkata, India. Shristi Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited is a subsidiary of Adishakti Commercial Private Limited.

Name: Crest Ventures Limited
Description: Crest Ventures Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. It operates through three segments: Real Estate, Financial Services, and Investment and Credit. The company develops various real estate projects, such as residential and commercial projects, as well as malls, hotels, and townships. It also provides financial services, including asset management; mutual fund distribution services; and investment management services to family offices and high net worth individuals, as well as deals in wholesale debt markets, foreign exchange markets, interest rate swaps, and currency options. In addition, the company offers destination and event management services, such as tours; meetings, incentives, conferencing, and exhibitions; events; and online services. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Vakrangee Limited
Description: Vakrangee Limited, a technology company, provides banking, financial, insurance, ATM, e-commerce, and logistics services in India. The company offers bank account opening, cash deposits and withdrawals, money transfer, fixed and recurring deposits, balance enquiry, statement of accounts, money disbursement, home and business loans, DEMAT account opening, PAN card, CIBIL score, and domestic money transfer services. It also offers life insurance, motor insurance, health insurance, and social security and micro insurance schemes, as well as owns and manages white label ATMs. In addition, the company provides e-commerce and logistics services, including assisted online shopping, healthcare and travel services, and telecom and bill payments services platforms, as well as offers courier booking services. Vakrangee Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Gujarat Credit Corporation Limited
Description: Gujarat Credit Corporation Limited operates as a real estate development company. The company engages in the development of a portfolio of commercial and residential projects. It also provides services, including site acquisition, design and development, construction, marketing, and sale. The company also provides materials, such as ready mixed concrete for real estate development. Gujarat Credit Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Sylph Technologies Limited
Description: Sylph Technologies Limited, a software technology company, provides software development services and solutions in India. The company operates through Information Technology, Education, Printing and Publishing Newspapers, and Trading of Solar Power Plant segments. It also offers outsourcing software development, web development, product development, strategy consulting, offshore software development, product migrations, and e-commerce for web and mobile enablement services. In addition, the company provides services in the field of accounting; income tax, service tax, VAT, CST, GST, custom duty, and other duties and taxes; and auditing, corporate services, company law matters, financial and legal consultancy, and tax management, as well as BPO and KPO Services. Further, it offers B2B and B2C e-commerce solutions, such as building framework, systems, tools, content, and interface design; client-server and enterprise applications; and web-enabled applications and systems. Additionally, the company provides software solutions for mobile devices, including enterprise, mobile marketing, mobile campaigns, mobile WAP site, messaging, and m-commerce solutions; sells solar power products; and publishes newspapers. Sylph Technologies Limited offers marketing services, including online/mobile marketing campaigns, market research, corporate strategy development, and competitive perception and analysis services. It serves retail, brand marketing, manufacturing, communication, education and training, and digital media markets. Sylph Technologies limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Indore, India.

Name: Dharani Finance Limited
Description: Dharani Finance Limited provides non-banking financial services in India. Dharani Finance Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: Alexander Stamps and Coin Limited
Description: Alexander Stamps and Coin Limited engages in the philatelic and numismatic activities worldwide. The company trades in stamps, coins, paper money, medals, postcards, original photos, autographs, newspapers, and numismatics collection. Alexander Stamps and Coin Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Vadodara, India.

Name: Indbank Merchant Banking Services Limited
Description: Indbank Merchant Banking Services Limited engages in the provision of merchant banking, stock broking, depository participant, and allied services in India. It offers merchant banking services for public issues, rights issues, private placement, acquisition of shares and takeovers, and employee stock option schemes/stock purchase scheme by corporates. The company also provides advisory services for valuation of shares and other financial instruments, syndication of loans, acquisitions, and mergers and amalgamations, as well as for project counseling, appraisal, and feasibility studies. In addition, it offers stock broking services in the cash, derivatives, and wholesale debt market segments for retail and institutional investors, as well as in cash management; online trading services; and e-services; as well as distributes mutual funds and other investment products. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Chennai, India. Indbank Merchant Banking Services Limited is a subsidiary of Indian Bank.

Name: Shrydus Industries Limited
Description: Shrydus Industries Limited engages in trading agricultural commodity products in India. The company also manufactures pharmaceuticals consist of tablets and capsules; and develops real estate properties. The company was formerly known as VCK Capital Market Services Limited and changed its name to Shrydus Industries Limited in May 2023. Shrydus Industries Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Bharat Bhushan Finance & Commodity Brokers Limited
Description: Bharat Bhushan Finance & Commodity Brokers Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the investment and securities trading business in India. The company trades in equities and derivatives, including futures contracts, forward contracts, options, and swaps, as well as depository services and commodities, such as agricultural products, metals, precious stones, diamonds, petroleum, and other energy products. It also offers spot commodities, currency derivatives, mutual funds, and IPO services. In addition, the company provides a range of public and private debt instruments, including fixed deposits, debentures, bonds, and government bonds. It serves corporates, trusts, institutions, high-net-worth individuals, and retail investors. The company was formerly known as Bharat Bhushan Share & Commodity Brokers Ltd. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Ushakiran Finance Limited
Description: Ushakiran Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in the financing and investments business in India. It offers financial and consulting services, including preparation of project reports, loan syndications, and capital and debt restructuring, etc. The company was formerly known as Ushakiran Finance and Industries Limited and changed its name to Ushakiran Finance Limited in November 1993. Ushakiran Finance Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

Name: Vivo Bio Tech Limited
Description: Vivo Bio Tech Limited provides drug development and discovery services to pharmaceutical and biotech companies worldwide. The company offers services in the areas of in vivo and in vitro toxicity studies, pharmacological investigations, pharmacokinetic and toxic kinetic studies, genotoxicity screening, and analytical services. It also supplies SPF lab animals; breeds and distributes rodent models; and offers custom rodent models, and stem cell products, as well as lab animal diets. In addition, the company provides regulatory and non-regulatory IND preclinical services; screening and evaluating molecules for various pharmacological properties; and designs and develops of syngeneic / xenograft models for evaluation of anti-cancer agents evaluation. The company was formerly known as Sunshine Factors & Exports Limited and changed its name to Vivo Bio Tech Limited in September 2002. Vivo Bio Tech Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

Name: Veerhealth Care Limited
Description: Veerhealth Care Limited engages in manufacturing, marketing, and trading of ayurvedic medicines in India. The company offers skincare products, such as creams, lip balms, moisturizing lotions, face packs, rosewater, and scrubs; body care products, including bodywash, bath salts, facewash, handwash, and soaps; hair oils, shampoos, and conditioners; candles and body mist fragrances; pain relief oils, tablets, syrups, and sanitizers; toothpastes; body and beard care products; gifting products; and accessories. It also provides plastic bottles for use in various industries comprising food, cosmetics, household cleaning, pharmaceuticals, and others. The company also sells its products online. It exports its products. In addition, it manufactures and sells anesthesia delivery equipment, air compressors, and ambulances for operating room, critical care, life support, imaging, and mobile healthcare sectors. The company was formerly known as Niyati Industries Limited and changed its name to Veerhealth Care Limited in September 2013. Veerhealth Care Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Pan India Corporation Limited
Description: Pan India Corporation Limited invests in, buys, sells, transfers, hypothecates, deals in, and disposes shares, stocks, debentures, debenture stocks, securities of government and local authority, bonds, certificates, and immovable or movable properties in India. The company acquires and leases industrial, office plant, equipment, and machinery, as well as vehicles, buildings, and real estate properties for manufacturing processes. It is also involved in transportation, trading, and other commercial services activities. The company was formerly known as SRG Infotec Ltd. Pan India Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Sahara Housingfina Corporation Limited
Description: Sahara Housingfina Corporation Limited provides housing finance for the purchase, construction, extension, repair, and renovation of houses to individuals and families in India. It also offers loans for families in the self-employed category where formal income proofs are not available. The company was formerly known as Livewell Home Finance Limited and changed its name to Sahara Housingfina Corporation Limited in January 2005. Sahara Housingfina Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Kolkata, India.

Name: NDA Securities Limited
Description: NDA Securities Limited offers stock broking services in India. The company provides equities, future and option trading, depository, mutual fund/IPO, research, and internet trading services. NDA Securities Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Supra Trends Limited
Description: Supra Trends Limited engages in the manufacture, processing, marketing, distributing, and sale of apparels, footwear and sportswear products, and other textiles goods in India. The company act as trading agent and undertakes job works. It is also involved in the importing and exporting activities; and offers paper and related products. The company was formerly known as Vijay Growth Financial Services Limited and changed its name to Supra Trends Limited in January 2014. Supra Trends Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

Name: GSB Finance Limited
Description: GSB Finance Limited engages in trading and investment in shares and securities in India. The company offers equity and derivative; advisory; HNI and institutional broking; and research services. It also provides mutual funds; and insurance products, such as health, motor, home, personal accident, travel, and commercial insurance. The company was formerly known as Ravi Cement Ltd and changed its name to GSB Finance Limited in August 1993. GSB Finance Limited was founded in 1957 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Morarka Finance Limited
Description: Morarka Finance Limited operates as a non-banking finance company primarily in India. The company offers services related to portfolio management, which include investment in securities, corporate advisory services, and advancing of loans. It also rents properties and offers management consultancy services. The company was formerly known as Morarka Holdings Limited and changed its name to Morarka Finance Limited in May 1993. Morarka Finance Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Monarch Networth Capital Limited
Description: Monarch Networth Capital Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services to high net worth individuals, institutional and foreign investors, financial institutions, and corporate clients in India. It operates through three segments: Broking & other Finance Market Services; Non Banking Finance Business; and Insurance Business. The company offers equity and derivatives, commodities, and currency derivatives; alternative investment fund; mutual funds; bond and FD; and TradingView, an investing and trading platform offering heatmaps, market data, and a real time economic calendar to track key financial events. It also provides initial public offering; life and general insurance; depository services; merchant banking services comprising capital/fund raising and financial advisory services, including services for initial public offer/follow-on public offer/offer for sale/rights issue/takeover/ buyback on main board and SME platform of BSE/NSE; and private equity/venture capital funding/angel investing/QIBs, as well as equity raising through private placements; and national pension systems. The company was formerly known as Networth Stock Broking Limited and changed its name to Monarch Networth Capital Limited in December 2015. Monarch Networth Capital Limited was founded in 1992 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Pro Fin Capital Services Ltd.
Description: Pro Fin Capital Services Ltd. provides financial services in India. The company invests and trades in shares and securities; and provides short-term loans and advances. Pro Fin Capital Services Ltd. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Team India Guaranty Limited
Description: Times Guaranty Limited, a non-deposit accepting non-banking financial company, provides investment and financial services in India. It focuses to invest own funds in safe debt instruments/eligible deposits. The company was formerly known as Times Guaranty Finance Limited and changed its name to Times Guaranty Limited in December 1999. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Sanchay Finvest Limited
Description: Sanchay Finvest Limited provides brokerage services in India. It also invests and trades in shares and equities, and debt mutual funds. The company was formerly known as D.S. Sancheti Securities & Finance and changed its name to Sanchay Finvest Limited in June 1999. Sanchay Finvest Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.

Name: Som Datt Finance Corporation Limited
Description: Som Datt Finance Corporation Limited, a non-banking finance company, primarily engages in investment and financing activities in India. It is involved in the proprietary investments in stocks and securities. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

Name: Not Found
Description: Savani Financials Limited, a medium size non-banking financial services company, provides investment and financial services in India. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited
Description: Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited provides non-banking financial and sub-broker advisory services in India. The company's Debt and Equity Market Operations segment deals/trades in securities and bonds. Its Consultancy and Advisory Fees segment offers merchant banking, underwriting commission, corporate and infrastructure advisory, loan syndication fees and arranger of debts/bonds, etc.; and advisory services related to infrastructure projects. The company's Wealth/Broking Activities segment is involved in stock and share broking, and other related services, as well as real estate broking services. Its Finance Activities segment grants loans. The company's Healthcare Services segment establishes, administers, owns, and operates eye care hospitals. Its Investment Activities segment engages in the investment activities. The company was formerly known as Almondz Capital & Management Services Limited. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

Name: Libord Finance Limited
Description: Libord Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the financial services, loan syndication, corporate advisory, and financial consultancy businesses in India. The company offers project finance, ECB, corporate loan, working capital, commercial papers, buyers/suppliers' credit, factoring/forfeiting, bill discounting/LC discounting, bank guarantee, lease/hire purchase assistance, securitization of receivable, loan against share/mutual fund units/corporate bonds/government securities, and private equity/venture capital funds services. It also provides financial engineering services, including debt restructuring under CDR/non-CDR mechanism; capital restructuring; merger, demerger, acquisition, take over, amalgamation, and spin off; preparation of rehabilitation scheme for submission to BIFR; induction of strategic investor; OTS with banks/asset reconstruction companies; and assistance in the sale of assets/companies. In addition, the company offers advisory services for transfer pricing, cross border transactions, and FEMA; SEBI rules and regulations; arbitration matters connected with BSE/NSE/CDSL/NSDL/MCX/NCDEX; import export policy, company law, and income tax; valuation of business/company; system planning; DRT/SARFAESI matters; sales tax, custom, excise, PF, and DGFT; formation of joint ventures with overseas partners; and public/rights issue. Further, it provides services to foreign enterprises, such as India entry strategy, Indian laws and procedures, approval from government authorities, market surveys, Indian partners for joint ventures, cross border transactions, transfer pricing, double taxation avoidance treaty, and setting up branch/representative offices. The company was formerly known as Libord Infotech Limited. Libord Finance Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Yash Management & Satellite Ltd.
Description: Yash Management & Satellite Ltd. engages in wholesale trading activities in India. It imports and exports agricultural products, such as food grains, pulses, and oil seeds, etc.; metals, including copper, iron, semi-precious metals, and precious metals; textile products; and other industrial products. Yash Management & Satellite Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: ISL Consulting Limited
Description: ISL Consulting Limited engages in investment, trading, and dealing in shares and securities in India. ISL Consulting Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: DCM Financial Services Limited
Description: DCM Financial Services Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was involved in financing operations, including inter corporate deposits and investments business. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: RR Financial Consultants Limited
Description: RR Financial Consultants Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in India. It offers mutual funds, fixed deposits, initial public offerings, wealth management products, and retail bonds; valuation for perquisites taxation, regulatory valuations, valuation for shares of closely held companies, and valuation of ESOP for accounting and other purposes; mergers and acquisitions, corporate finance, primary debt markets, project finance and advisory, private equity advisory, research, restructuring advisory, and risk management services; and insurance services comprising health, property, liability, motor, fire, united linked, life, marine, accident, casualty, vehicle, and travel. The company also provides stock broking, commodity futures, commodity spots, currency futures, depository services, and interest rate futures. In addition, it offers investment banking and lending services. The company serves corporate houses, institutions, banks, asset management companies, and investors. RR Financial Consultants Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

Name: Sambhaav Media Limited
Description: Sambhaav Media Limited engages in the publishing of newspapers and magazines, radio broadcasting, and audio video media businesses in India. The company operates through Media and Allied Business, Technology and Allied Business, and Others Segments. It also offers Sambhaav Metro, an afternoon-daily; Abhiyyan, a Gujarati magazine; and VTVGujarati, a digital publication of news and entertainment. In addition, the company operates VTV News, a Gujarati news channel; Wise TV, an in-transit TV channel; TOP FM radio offers sweet melodies of bollywood and regional music in Gujarat, Jammu, and Ladakhs virgin market. Further, it operates FM radio stations in Gujarat, Ladakh, and Jammu & Kashmir, as well as offers integrated vehicle tracking and passenger information systems for buses. Additionally, the company is involved in the supply, installation, testing, integration and commissioning, and training for electrical smart power fence works. Sambhaav Media Limited operates www.sambhaav.com, www.vtvgujarthi.com, www.vtvnews.co.in, www.abhiyaanmagazine.com, and www.topfm.in web portals for news, entertainment, gaming, and knowledge sharing activities; and web applications. The company was formerly known as Pearl Energy and Infrastructures Limited. Sambhaav Media Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Omega Interactive Technologies Limited
Description: Omega Interactive Technologies Limited engages in the information technology business in India. It is involved in the development and consulting of software. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Sugal & Damani Share Brokers Limited
Description: Sugal & Damani Share Brokers Limited provides share broking services in India. It operates in two segments, Stock Brokering and Real Estate. The company offers equities and derivatives; depository services, including demarterilisation, account opening, and charges for DP; and online client and trading services. It is also involved in buying, selling, and dealing in shares and other securities in secondary markets; and develops and sells plotted land. The company was formerly known as Sugal & Damani Finlease Limited and changed its name to Sugal & Damani Share Brokers Limited in December 2008. Sugal & Damani Share Brokers Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: Nettlinx Limited
Description: Nettlinx Limited provides internet solutions for data voice, and security and software development to corporate customers in India. The company offers internet services, including leased lines; and information technology support services comprising servers, routers, and networks switches; cabling, wireless equipment, and Wi-Fi devices; firewalls; digital light processing and liquid crystal display projectors; mobile jammers; printers/photocopiers/scanners; internal LAN projects; CCTV and security surveillance; biometric; technical manpower services; web hosting services; co-location services; managed data center services; and information technology support services for system administration, system architect, data center support, business continuity, disaster recovery, storage, backup, and virtualization. It also provides software consulting, network services, application development, and outsourcing and managed cloud services. In addition, it is involved in the real estate development and renewable energy businesses, as well as acts as an advisor for M&A and financing of M&A transactions. Nettlinx Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

Name: Scan Steels Limited
Description: Scan Steels Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of steel products under the SHRISHTII brand name in India. The company offers thermo mechanical treatment bars, mild steel ingots and billets, and sponge iron, as well as structures, such as flats, angles, square bars, channels, and round-plain rods. It also provides pre-coated corrugated profile sheets and roofing accessories under the brand name SHRISHTII ROOFING; and fly ash bricks. The company is based in Bhubaneswar, India.

Name: GIC Housing Finance Limited
Description: GIC Housing Finance Limited provides housing finance services in India. The company grants housing loans to individuals and to persons/entities engaged in construction of houses/flats for residential purposes. It also provides home loans comprising individual housing, composite, repair and renovation, and home extension loans, as well as balance transfer services; and non housing loans, such as loan against housing property and commercial loans. The company was formerly known as GIC Grih Vitta Limited and changed its name to GIC Housing Finance Limited in November 1993. GIC Housing Finance Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Mathew Easow Research Securities Limited
Description: Mathew Easow Research Securities Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the investment and finance activities in India. The company assists corporate bodies through the syndication of loans from various bodies, including corporate/banks and financial institutions. It also trades in shares. Mathew Easow Research Securities Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Kolkata, India.

Name: Ajcon Global Services Limited
Description: Ajcon Global Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in India. It offers equity, F&O, currency, commodity, equity research, institutional broking and depository, investment and merchant banking, portfolio analysis, corporate advisory, financial crime training, home finance and loan against property, as well as e-IPO, insurance, and knowledge room services. The company was formerly known as Ajcon Capital Markets Ltd. and changed its name to Ajcon Global Services Limited in March 2003. Ajcon Global Services Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Chartered Capital and Investment Limited
Description: Chartered Capital and Investment Limited provides consultancy and merchant banking services in India. The company engages in the management of public issues, right issues, buyback offers, takeover offers, delisting offers, qualified institutions placement, and employee stock option and employee stock purchase schemes. It also offers valuation and other corporate advisory services. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Standard Capital Markets Limited
Description: Standard Capital Markets Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers personal, gold, syndicated, and working capital loans. It provides a range of financial services, such as lending of money to individuals and small and medium sized enterprises with or without security; dealing in securities/shares of companies; and bonds and units investment in stock markets. The company also manufactures and trades in brooms. Standard Capital Markets Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Yogi Limited
Description: Yogi Limited engages in real estate development business in India. It is also involved in construction and infrastructure development activities. The company was formerly known as Parsharti Investment Limited and changed its name to Yogi Limited in June 2022. Yogi Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Cubical Financial Services Limited
Description: Cubical Financial Services, Ltd. is a publicly owned investment manager. It engages in the business of investment in securities in primary and secondary markets. The firm also invests in financial markets, stocks & properties etc. The company was formerly known as Cubical Financial Services Pvt., Ltd. and Cubical Construction Pvt., Ltd. Cubical Financial Services, Ltd. was founded in May, 1990 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Relic Technologies Limited
Description: Relic Technologies Limited engages in the share broking business in India. It serves institutional clients. The company was formerly known as Relic Finance Limited and changed its name to Relic Technologies Limited in April 2000. Relic Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Nimbus Projects Limited
Description: Nimbus Projects Limited develops real estate properties for residential, commercial, and retail purposes in India. The company develops townships, group housing, office spaces, commercial-shopping malls, and hotel and resorts. It is also involved in the land identification and acquisition, project planning and management, designing, marketing, and execution activities; and provision of real estate consultancy, investment advisory, and construction services. The company was formerly known as NCJ International Limited and changed its name to Nimbus Projects Limited in December 2010. Nimbus Projects Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Invigorated Business Consulting Limited
Description: Invigorated Business Consulting Limited provides leasing advisory and counselling services in India. The company was formerly known as Escorts Finance Limited and changed its name to Invigorated Business Consulting Limited in June 2023. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Faridabad, India. Invigorated Business Consulting Limited is a subsidiary of Escorts Benefit and Welfare Trust.

Name: Baid Finserv Limited
Description: Baid Finserv Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company provides car loans, commercial vehicle loans, tractors, small and medium enterprise loans, loan against property, and construction equipment loans. It also offers life, dwelling, and motor insurance products. Baid Finserv Limited was formerly known as Baid Leasing and Finance Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Baid Finserv Limited in July 2022. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Jaipur, India.

Name: K Z Leasing and Finance Limited
Description: K Z Leasing and Finance Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. It is involved in finance activities, as well as provision of loans. K Z Leasing and Finance Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Avasara Finance Ltd

Its products used by scientists and engineers in various fields, including medical research, environmental sciences, geo sciences, chemistry, aerospace, biotech, telecommunication, automotive, physics, life sciences, quality control, biology, materials characteristics, pathology, engineering, etc. Cranes Software International Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

Garnet International Limited was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Shalimar Productions Limited
Description: Shalimar Productions Limited engages in the media and entertainment business in India. It produces films, various regional albums, and movies. The company was formerly known as Shalimar Agro Productions Limited and changed its name to Shalimar Productions Limited in March 2004. Shalimar Productions Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Donear Industries Limited
Description: Donear Industries Limited primarily engages in manufacturing of fabrics under Donear brand name, and trading of garments under Dcot brand name in India and internationally. It operates through two segments: Textiles and Rentals. The company offers fabrics with various finishes, including wrinkle resistance, moisture absorbent, odor resistance, and 4-way stretch. It also provides ready-to-wear products, such as suits, shirts, trousers, denims, t-shirts, corduroy, workwear, and various accessories; and manufacturers and sells dyed polyester and cotton yarn. In addition, the company involved in property rental activities. The company offers its products under Donear, MAYUR, Ferrino Mizzoni, EURICO, Vestito, D'cot and Donear NXG brand names to automotive, aviation, industrial, and defense industries, as well as government bodies and educational institutions. Donear Industries Limited was founded in 1979 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Super Sales India Limited
Description: Super Sales India Limited manufactures and sells yarns in India and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Agency, Textiles, and Engineering. The company sells machinery and equipment, such as blow rooms, auto blend, cards, CDS, draw frames, lap former, combers, speed and smart ring frames, and spinpact. It produces cotton yarns, including hosiery, weaving, siro compact, weaving, knitting, and TFO doubled yarns. In addition, the company manufactures various spur gears, helical gears, worm gears, timing belt pulleys, bevel gears, ring gears. It serves construction, cement, textile, recycling, paper, steel, food, mining, material handling, sugar, power, rubber, plastic, crane, chemical, packaging, foundry, and agriculture industries. The company was formerly known as Super Sales Agencies Limited and changed its name to Super Sales India Limited in 2005. Super Sales India Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Coimbatore, India.

Name: Sequent Scientific Limited
Description: Sequent Scientific Limited operates in the veterinary healthcare business in Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company provides animal health active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) formulations in the areas of anthelmintics, including endo and ecto parasiticides; and anti-protozoal, nutraceuticals, nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, anti-infectives, and dermatology. It also offers analytical solutions that support API, pharmaceutical, personal care, and nutraceutical organizations; and method validation, stability, and microbiology for APIs and finished products. The company was formerly known as PI Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. and changed its name to Sequent Scientific Limited in October 2009. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Sequent Scientific Limited is a subsidiary of CA Harbor Investments.

Name: The State Trading Corporation of India Limited
Description: The State Trading Corporation of India Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it traded in rice, wheat, sugar, pulses, edible oils, fertilizers, coals, bullions, caster oils, hydrocarbons, metals, minerals, ores, and petrochemicals. The State Trading Corporation of India Limited was incorporated in 1956 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Zenith Exports Limited
Description: Zenith Exports Limited engages in the leather goods and textile fabrics businesses for the home and apparel industries in India and internationally. It operates through Silk Fabrics & Made-ups; Industrial Leather H/Gloves & Made-Ups; Yarns; and Weavings Silk Fabrics (100% EOU) segments. The company offers silk, velvet, and cotton fabrics; industrial leather hand gloves; and made ups. It also trades in cotton. The company exports its products. Zenith Exports Limited was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

Name: Kohinoor Foods Limited
Description: Kohinoor Foods Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells food products in India. The company provides basmati, non-basmati, and organic rice. It also offers packaged food products, such as ready to eat food; ready to cook; frozen food, including paneer, currries, bread, snacks, biryani, and desserts; Indian namkeen; whole and ground spices; and rice bran oil. The company sells its products under the Kohinoor and Monsoon brands. The company was formerly known as Satnam Overseas Limited and changed its name to Kohinoor Foods Limited in 1989. Kohinoor Foods Limited was founded in 1976 and is based in Faridabad, India.

Name: Zodiac-JRD-MKJ Limited
Description: Zodiac-JRD-MKJ Limited engages in the manufacture, sale, and trading of gold and diamond jewelry in India. It also offers cut and polished diamonds, precious stones, and semi-precious stones. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Sita Enterprises Limited
Description: Sita Enterprises Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in investment and finance activities in India. The company invests funds in shares, securities, and properties, as well as mutual funds. It is also involved in financing activities through loans and trade receivables. Sita Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Pulsar International Limited
Description: Pulsar International Limited engages in buying and selling of consumer goods in India. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Adani Enterprises Limited
Description: Adani Enterprises Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates in the new energy ecosystem, data center, airports, roads, copper, digital space, and other sectors in India and internationally. It operates through the Integrated Resources Management (IRM), Mining Services, Commercial Mining, New Energy Ecosystem, Airport, Road, and Others segments. The company engages in the integrated ecosystem for manufacturing green hydrogen, including solar cells, modules, and wind manufacturing; construction, operation, and maintenance of airports and road assets; commercial mining activities; supply of bunker to fuels to shipping vessels; manufacture and supply of defense equipment; and copper smelting and refinery, as well metals manufacturing. It also provides airport-focused services, including duty-free shopping, food and beverages, car parking, meet-and-greet, flight tracking, and airport maps services; and procurement and logistics services for minerals, as well as mining services. In addition, the company is involved in the sourcing, storage, and marketing of apples, grapes, pomegranates, and frozen peas; wastewater treatment, recycling, and reuse projects; a operation of a news network. Further, it holds a portfolio of small arms, ammunition, unmanned aerial vehicles, counter-drone systems, missiles, and aircraft services. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India. Adani Enterprises Limited operates as a subsidiary of S.B. Adani Family Trust.

Name: Haria Exports Limited
Description: Haria Exports Limited engages in trading of textiles and fabrics in India. It is involved in manufacture and export of garments, including apparels and clothing, cushions and bedcovers, napkins, table linen, towels, readymade garments, uniforms, athletic sportswear, curtains, knitted garments, industrial fabrics, accessories and material supplies, promotions caps, t-shirts, sportswear and accessories for men, women and children; manufacture of notebooks under the Haria brand; and rental businesses. The company also provides services, such as advisory; arbitration and remediation, due diligence; commercial and business contracts; drafting and pleading; litigation; and licensing. It exports its products. Haria Exports Limited was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: RLF Limited
Description: RLF Limited engages in the textile business in India. It is also involved in the embroidery; and marble and red stone business. In addition, the company engages in sports center, club, education, recreation, restaurant, F and B, accommodation, and other amenities; and provision of land for warehousing. Storage, and other related activities. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Gurugram, India.

Name: Regent Enterprises Limited
Description: Regent Enterprises Limited engages in the trading, packaging, and sale of edible oils primarily in India. It provides soyabean, mustard, sunflower, groundnut, canola, palmoleine, blended vegetable, and olive pomace oils. The company offers its products under the Maanik, Gio, Moti, Shaan, Gio Lite, Pearl Lite, and Giolly brands. The company was formerly known as Spine Traders Limited and changed its name to Regent Enterprises Limited in June 2015. Regent Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Ghaziabad, India.

Name: Orbit Exports Limited
Description: Orbit Exports Limited manufactures and sells novelty fabrics in India, the United States of America, Latin America, Africa, Europe, and the Far East. It operates through Manufacturing of Textile and Windmill Power Generation segments. The company offers everyday home textile products, such as cushions and table linen; and seasonal home textile products, including ribbons and ornaments, and tree skirts and stockings. It also provides fashion fabrics comprising silky aspects and fashion jacquards, tailoring fabrics, and casual fashion. The company exports its products. Orbit Exports Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Savera Industries Limited
Description: Savera Industries Limited engages in the hoteliering business in India. The company operates Savera Hotel, a four-star hotel with facilities comprising rooms, food and beverage outlets, conference and meeting venues, and leisure facilities in Chennai. Savera Industries Limited was founded in 1968 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: Nava Limited
Description: Nava Limited engages in the ferro alloys, power, mining, and healthcare businesses in India and internationally. It operates through Ferro Alloys, Power, and Mining Segment. It generates and sells power using coal, biomass, biogas, and bagasse. The company operates 150 MW and 114 MW coal-fired power plants in Paloncha, Telangana; 150 MW coal-fired power plant in Kharagprasad, Odisha; 20 MW and 9MW bagasse power plant in Dharmavaram and samalkot, Andhra Pradesh; and 300 MW thermal power plant in Zambia. It also mines coal at Maamba in Southern province of Zambia, as well as provides operation and maintenance services for power plants. In addition, the company provides various alloy metals, such as ferro and silico manganese that are used in automotive, railways, and construction industries, as well as in the manufacture of stainless-steel consumer goods. Further, it operates a medical clinic for the management of iron deficiency and the administration of intravenous iron in Singapore; and in-licenses pharmaceutical products. Additionally, the company engages in the agriculture business. The company was formerly known as Nava Bharat Ventures Limited and changed its name to Nava Limited in July 2022. Nava Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

Name: Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Limited
Description: Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Limited engages in manufacture and sale of stainless steel pipes and tubes in India. The company offers welded and seamless cold finish tubes; large diameter electric fusion welded pipes; TIG welded and seamless pipes and tubes; and welded condenser and feed water heater tubes for power plants. It is also involved in the wind power generation. The company offers its products for various industries, such as refineries, petrochemicals, fertilizers, pharmaceuticals, paper and pulp, etc. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Rajendra Mechanical Industries Ltd. and changed its name to Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Limited in November 2009. Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: G.S. Auto International Limited
Description: G.S. Auto International Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive suspension and fastening components for passenger cars, utility vehicles, commercial vehicles, multi-axle vehicles, trailers, and special purpose vehicles. The company operates through three segments: Original Equipment Manufacturers, After Sales Market, and Export Market. It offers auto components, such as ferrous and non-ferrous casting components, machined components, forged parts, and assembly of heavy-duty trailer axles. The company's automotive products include leaf bolt, spring bolt W nut, casting products, bushes, hub bolts, nuts, pins, trailer axles, and trailer suspension and sub assemblies. It also provides earth moving and construction components, including pins, side cutter, teeth, bushes, and fasteners; and propeller shaft components, such as leaf spring, full yoke, rear teeth, cross holder, coupling flange, half yoke, water pump assy, UJ cross, tie rod end and drag link kits, wheel spanners, and jack pod, as well as offers designing solutions for product performance and quality improvement. The company operates in India, the United Kingdom, Germany, Holland, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, Iran, the United Arab Emirates, the United States, Morocco, Egypt, the Philippines, Afghanistan, Singapore, Bahrain, Kuwait, and Kenya. The company was formerly known as Gurmukh Singh & Sons Auto Parts Private Limited and changed its name to G.S. Auto International Limited in 1985. G.S. Auto International Limited was founded in 1938 and is based in Ludhiana, India.

Name: Trans Freight Containers Limited
Description: Trans Freight Containers Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was engaged in the manufacture and export of marine freight cargo containers; and truck body panels, which have applications in the pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, electronic and the white goods industries. Trans Freight Containers Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Gandhi Special Tubes Limited
Description: Gandhi Special Tubes Limited manufactures and markets welded and seamless steel tubes, and nuts in India and internationally. The company offers cold drawn bright annealed seamless steel tubes; precision electric resistance welded steel tubes; cold formed coupling nuts; and high pressure fuel injection tubes. It supplies its products primarily to the original equipment manufacturers of the automotive sector, farm equipment manufacturers, construction equipment manufacturers, and other engineering industries. The company is also involved in the wind power generation business. The company was formerly known as Gandhi Special 07 Tubes Ltd. Gandhi Special Tubes Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Amforge Industries Limited
Description: Amforge Industries Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was engaged in the manufacturing and trading of steel products. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Acrow India Limited
Description: Acrow India Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, the company provided machinery equipment, including material handling systems, sugar graders, hoppers, elevators, electronic weighting and bagging systems, and industrial storage systems. It intends to explore the cotton, clothing, yarn, construction, and development of real estate businesses. Acrow India Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Aurangabad, India.

Name: Steel Strips Infrastructures Limited
Description: Steel Strips Infrastructures Limited engages in the infrastructure, real estate, trading, and commission businesses primarily in India. It is also involved in the rental of commercial properties. The company was formerly known as Steel Strips & Tubes Limited. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Chandigarh, India.

Name: Pennar Industries Limited
Description: Pennar Industries Limited operates as an engineering company in India and internationally. It operates in Diversified Engineering, and Custom Designed Building Solutions and Auxiliaries segments. The company offers engineered components, including automotive and white goods components, hydraulic cylinders, and precision sub assembly parts; precision tubes comprising electric resistance welding, CWE/DOM/CEW, bicycle frame, steel, engineering, boiler, heat exchanger, propeller shaft, transformer, fuel and air, furniture, structural, telescopic front fork, and air pre-heater tubes, as well as automotive shock absorbers; and railway wagons, and passenger and metro coaches. It also provides steel products and profiles, such as cold rolled steel strips; electrostatic precipitator electrodes; building components, including purlins, roofing/cladding sheets, and decking profiles; metal crash barriers for flyovers, bridges, national highways, and other projects; sheet piles for infrastructure projects; and automobile products. In addition, the company offers solar module mounting structures to support the solar PV panels; aerospace machined components; industrial boilers and heaters; and water treatment chemicals, fuel additives, and specialty water treatment chemicals, as well as water and environment infrastructure turnkey solutions. Further, the company designs, fabricates, and erects industries, warehouses, commercial centers, multi storied buildings, aircraft hangars, defense installations, metro stations, stadiums, and power plants. Additionally, it provides structural engineering, building information modelling, plant and product engineering, industrial automation, and digital consultancy (IoT) and value-added solutions; design and engineering services; pre-engineered buildings; and solar structures. Pennar Industries Limited was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

Name: Jyoti Structures Limited
Description: Jyoti Structures Limited manufactures and sells transmission line towers, substation structures, and tall antenna towers/masts in India and internationally. The company is involved in turnkey/ engineering procurement construction projects that include the survey, design, foundation, fabrication, erection, and stringing activities of high voltage transmission lines; and procurement of bought out items; supply of lattice and pipe type structures; civil works; and erection, testing, and commissioning of switchyard/substations and distribution networks. It also undertakes solar power and rural electrification projects. Jyoti Structures Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Jay Ushin Limited
Description: Jay Ushin Limited engages in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of lock and key sets, door latches, heater control panels (HVAC), and switches for automobiles in India and internationally. The company provides lockset two and four wheelers, HVAC, door latches, instrument cluster two and four wheelers, and speed sensors. It also offers molds, dies, jigs, and fixtures; electronics and energy products, such as energy meters, batteries, lithium-batteries, and solar panels, as well as surface mount technology; and LED bulbs and lights. In addition, the company provides magnesium dies, gravity die casting, alloy wheels/low pressure die casting, and high pressure die casting products. Jay Ushin Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Steel Strips Wheels Limited
Description: Steel Strips Wheels Limited engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of automotive wheel rims and other auto components in India and internationally. It offers steel wheels rims, alloy wheel rims, and hot rolling mills for two and three wheelers, passenger cars, multi utility vehicles, tractors, commercial vehicles, and OTR vehicles. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Chandigarh, India.

Name: Man Industries (India) Limited
Description: Man Industries (India) Limited manufactures, processes, and trades in submerged arc welded pipes and steel products in India. The company offers coating systems, which include internal blasting and painting, coal tar enamel; ERW pipes, steel bends, and stainless steel; fusion bonded epoxy, 3 layer polyethylene, and 3 layer polypropylene coating systems. It also offers longitudinal submerged and helically submerged arc welded line pipes for use in oil, gas, petrochemicals, water dredging, fertilizers sectors. The company exports its products. Man Industries (India) Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Mumbai, India.

Name: Modern Steels Limited
Description: Modern Steels Limited manufactures and sells steel products in India. Modern Steels Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Chandigarh, India.

Name: Synthiko Foils Limited
Description: Synthiko Foils Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of aluminum packaging foils products in India. It offers alu alu foils, lidding foil, two ply and three ply laminates, blister foil, printed aluminum foil, laminated aluminum foil, and aluminum foil lids products. The company also exports its products. Synthiko Foils Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Jawhar, India.

Name: Golkonda Aluminium Extrusions Limited
Description: Golkonda Aluminium Extrusions Limited engages in trading of scrap material of ferrous and non-ferrous metal products in India. The company was formerly known as Alumeco India Extrusion Limited and changed its name to Golkonda Aluminium Extrusions Limited in July 2015 The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Gujarat Toolroom Limited
Description: Gujarat Toolroom Limited operates as trading company in India. The company trades in silver conductive ink, agriculture commodities, construction materials, and fabrics. It is also involved in buying and selling of securities. Gujarat Toolroom Limited serves solar cell, optoelectronics, photovoltaics, bio-sensors, printed electronics, digital printing, radio-frequency identification, and aerospace sectors. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited
Description: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development business in India. It constructs and develops residential and commercial projects. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Mumbai, India. Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited is a subsidiary of Ariil Trust.

Name: Cochin Minerals and Rutile Limited
Description: Cochin Minerals and Rutile Limited engages in the manufacturing, marketing, and research activities in the mineral processing sector in India. Its primary product is synthetic rutile, a raw material for use in the titanium pigment, and sponge/metal industry. The company also provides by-products, including ferric chloride, which is used as an etching agent, as well as a coagulant for purification of drinking water and for industrial waste water/sewage treatment; ferrous chloride, a coagulant for waste water from paper and pulp and textile processing industries and for waste mud in chromium industries; iron hydroxide for use in cement, steel, and ceramic industries as a substitute for iron ore; recovered TiO2, a substitute for TiO2 for paint industry; CMRL BF protector for use as hearth-protecting material in the blast furnaces; and CMRL rutoweld, a flux for use in welding electrode industry. It also exports its products. Cochin Minerals and Rutile Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Aluva, India.

Name: India Steel Works Limited
Description: India Steel Works Limited engages in the manufacture and trading of stainless-steel and alloy steel long products primarily in India. It offers hot rolled products, including wire rods, round bars, cast billets, rolled billets, and cut billets; bright bar products; and wires. The company was formerly known as Isibars Limited and changed its name to India Steel Works Limited in October 2007. India Steel Works Limited was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

Name: Krishanveer Forge Limited
Description: Krishanveer Forge Limited manufactures and sells open die forging products in India and internationally. The company offers plain carbon steels, alloy steels and stainless steels, and shape components; and shafts, square and rectangular section, blanks, rings, and hollow products. It serves its products to oil and gas, infrastructure, power transmission, mining and construction, gear box manufacturing, steel plants, cement, sugar mills, infrastructure, windmill, and other sectors. The company was formerly known as Rajkumar Forge Limited and changed its name to Krishanveer Forge Limited in August 2022. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Pune, India. Krishanveer Forge Limited operates as a subsidiary of Western India Forgings Pvt. Limited.

Name: Carborundum Universal Limited
Description: Carborundum Universal Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells abrasives, ceramics, and electrominerals in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Surface Engineering; Technical Ceramics and Super Refractory Solutions; and Electrominerals. The company offers bonded and coated abrasives, metal working fluids, power tools, non-woven, and tools for stones; and electro minerals, such as alumina, carbides, zirconia, and grit powders. It also provides industrial ceramics used in chemical, defense, electronics, energy, food, heavy industries, lifestyle, medical, and minerals and metallurgy industries; and manufactures super refractories, including as acid proof cement, polymer concrete, anti-corrosive coatings and screedings, construction chemicals, concrete repair and rehabilitation materials, fibre reinforced plastic chemical process equipment, and pipes and fittings for handling corrosives. In addition, the company provides IT infrastructure facility management, software application development, remote infrastructure management, and IT security management services; and operates gas-based power generation facility. Carborundum Universal Limited was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Chennai, India.

Name: MMTC Limited
Description: MMTC Limited operates as a trading company in Asia, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, and North America. It operates through Minerals, Precious Metals, Metals, Agro Products, Coal & Hydrocarbon, Fertilizer, and General Trade/others segments. The company engages in the trading of agro products, coal and hydrocarbon products, fertilizers and chemicals, precious metals, non-ferrous metals, metals and industrial raw materials, minerals, and gems and jewellery, as well as involved in PMD retail; and projects and general trade activities. It also trades wind power generated by the wind farm located at Gajendragad in Karnataka. MMTC Limited was incorporated in 1963 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: Vallabh Steels Limited
Description: Vallabh Steels Limited engages in the manufacturing and marketing of steel coating products in India. It offers galvanized coils/sheets, pre-painted galvanized coils and sheets, galvanized and precision steel tubes, galvanized steel pipes, steel square tube, galvanized and pre-painted corrugated sheets, pre- painted trapezoidal/tile profile sheets, and PUF panels. The company sells its products under the OSWAL brand name. Vallabh Steels Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Ludhiana, India.

Name: Ashiana Ispat Limited
Description: Ashiana Ispat Limited manufactures and sells steel products for construction, engineering, automotive, and infrastructure sectors in India. It also offers TMT bars. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in New Delhi, India.

Name: P.M. Telelinnks Limited
Description: P.M. Telelinnks Limited trades in iron and steel products in India. It sells TMT bars, rebars, tower parts, etc. P.M. Telelinnks Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Secunderabad, India.

Name: Smiths & Founders (India) Limited
Description: Smiths & Founders (India) Limited manufactures and sells forgings and machined components in India. The company's forgings include automobile components, including rocker arms, connecting rods, tie rod ends yokes, spiders, clutch hubs, clutch release levers, clevis, clutch plates, pressure plates, etc.; and general engineering products, such as gear blanks, wheel dressers, insulator pins, insulator hooks, tool holders, shackles, rotating eyes, chain links, and other products. Its forgings also comprise hydraulic forgings, including valve bodies, rod eye ends, elbows, ports, etc.; mining tools, including coal augurs, rotary drill bits, mining picks, bit holders, pick holders, etc.; and agricultural implements consisting of rotary tines, rotovator shovels, cultivator blades, etc. The company was formerly known as Shimoga Technologies Limited and changed its name to Smiths & Founders (India) Limited in March 2014. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

Name: Bloom Industries Limited
Description: Bloom Industries Limited engages in the trading of iron and steel business in India. The company was formerly known as Bakrewala Steels Limited and changed its name to Bloom Industries Limited in October 1994. Bloom Industries Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Rourkela, India.

Name: Maitri Enterprises Limited
Description: Maitri Enterprises Limited primarily engages in the trading of pharmaceutical and medical goods in India. The company operates through two segments, Pharmaceutical Goods and Sale of Service by Way of Works Contract. It offers pharmaceuticals products, including generic and non-generic medicines. The company also trades in metal furniture and trades in building materials. In addition, it engages in the construction and developmental of real-estate properties. The company was formerly known as Parth Alluminium Limited and changed its name to Maitri Enterprises Limited in December 2016. Maitri Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

Name: Tata Metaliks Limited
